== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L270-L290
   270  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   271    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   272    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   273    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   274    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   275    is closed) -/
   276    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   277      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   278    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   279    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   280      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   281    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   282    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   283    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   284    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   285    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   286    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   287    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   288      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   289      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   290      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L150-L160
   150  noncomputable def interp : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → V
   151    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   152    | _, .sort u => univ u
   153    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   154    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)
   155    | ρ, .lam v A b => lamR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) b
   156    | ρ, .pi _ v A B => piR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B
   157    | ρ, .eqE a b => eqv (interp ρ a) (interp ρ b)
   158    | ρ, .fst e => sfst (interp ρ e)
   159    | ρ, .snd e => ssnd (interp ρ e)
   160    | _, .prf => pt

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L56-L70
    56  def WellDenoted : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → Prop
    57    | ρ, .pi _u _v A B =>
    58      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    59      ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) B
    60    | ρ, .lam v A b =>
    61      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    62      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) b) ∧
    63      ∃ B : V → V,
    64        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → interp V (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) ∧
    65        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))
    66    | ρ, .app f a =>
    67      WellDenoted ρ f ∧ WellDenoted ρ a ∧
    68      ∃ (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V),
    69        interp V ρ f ∈ˢ piR v A B ∧ interp V ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
    70        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))

    35    | sort (l : Level)

    43    /-- The dependent product `(x : A) → B`, annotated with when `B` is a

    46    deriving DecidableEq

== whitepaper/Fragment/PropWhen.lean#L176-L194
   176  /-- **When a binder's body is a proposition**: never, or exactly at the
   177  valuations where every parameter of the set is zero.  (`whenZero ∅` is
   178  "always".) -/
   179  inductive PropWhen where
   180    /-- The body is never a proposition — the *graph regime*, where the
   181    β rule needs no certificate (`Red.betaGate`). -/
   182    | never
   183    /-- The body is a proposition exactly when these level parameters
   184    are all zero. -/
   185    | whenZero (ps : ParamSet)
   186    deriving DecidableEq
   187  
   188  namespace PropWhen
   189  
   190  /-- The readout at a valuation: is the body a proposition here? -/
   191  def holds (pw : PropWhen) (φ : Name → Nat) : Bool :=
   192    match pw with
   193    | never => false
   194    | whenZero ps => ps.list.all fun n => φ n == 0

== ConLeche/Kernel/PropWhen.lean#L407-L409
   407  structure PropWhen where
   408    private ofRepr ::
   409    private repr : PropWhenRepr

== ConLeche/Kernel/PropWhen.lean#L688-L694
   688  def holds (φ : Name → Nat) (pw : PropWhen) : Bool :=
   689    match pw.repr with
   690    | .never => false
   691    | .always => true
   692    | .one p => φ p == 0
   693    | .two p q _ => (φ p == 0) && (φ q == 0)
   694    | .many ps _ => ps.all fun n => φ n == 0

   232  /-- **Canonicity**: two data are equal exactly when their readouts agree
   233  at every valuation.  So the checker compares annotations with `=`, and
   234  that comparison is semantic. -/
   235  theorem eq_iff (a b : PropWhen) : a = b ↔ ∀ φ : Name → Nat, holds a φ = holds b φ := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/Syntax.lean#L62-L71
    62  /-- Instantiate the bound variable `k` by `a` (and lower the indices
    63  above it): `e.inst a` is `e[x := a]` for the innermost binder. -/
    64  def inst : Expr → Expr → (k : Nat := 0) → Expr
    65    | bvar i, a, k =>
    66      if i < k then bvar i else if i = k then liftN k a else bvar (i - 1)
    67    | sort u, _, _ => sort u
    68    | const c ls, _, _ => const c ls
    69    | app f b, a, k => app (inst f a k) (inst b a k)
    70    | lam A pw b, a, k => lam (inst A a k) pw (inst b a (k + 1))
    71    | pi A pw B, a, k => pi (inst A a k) pw (inst B a (k + 1))

== ConLeche/Kernel/ExprOps.lean#L33-L45
    33  def instantiate1 (e : Expr) (v : Expr) (d : Nat := 0) : Expr :=
    34    match e with
    35    | .bvar i => if i = d then v else if i > d then .bvar (i - 1) else .bvar i
    36    | .fvar idx ty => .fvar idx ty
    37    | .sort u => .sort u
    38    | .const n us => .const n us
    39    | .app f a => .app (instantiate1 f v d) (instantiate1 a v d)
    40    | .lam ty body bi => .lam (instantiate1 ty v d) (instantiate1 body v (d + 1)) bi
    41    | .forallE ty body bi => .forallE (instantiate1 ty v d) (instantiate1 body v (d + 1)) bi
    42    | .letE ty val body =>
    43      .letE (instantiate1 ty v d) (instantiate1 val v d) (instantiate1 body v (d + 1))
    44    | .lit l => .lit l
    45    | .proj s i e => .proj s i (instantiate1 e v d)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Level.lean#L32-L46
    32  /-- Universe levels (`Lean.Level` without `mvar`). -/
    33  inductive Level where
    34    /-- `Prop`'s level, `0`. -/
    35    | zero
    36    /-- The successor level `u + 1`. -/
    37    | succ (l : Level)
    38    /-- The maximum `max u v`. -/
    39    | max (a b : Level)
    40    /-- The impredicative maximum: `imax u v` is `0` when `v` is `0`,
    41    else `max u v` — so a `∀` whose codomain is a proposition is a
    42    proposition whatever its domain's level. -/
    43    | imax (a b : Level)
    44    /-- A level parameter of the enclosing declaration. -/
    45    | param (n : Name)
    46    deriving DecidableEq, Repr

== ConLeche/Kernel/Expr.lean#L39-L44
    39  inductive Level where
    40    | zero
    41    | succ (u : Level)
    42    | max (u v : Level)
    43    | imax (u v : Level)
    44    | param (n : Name)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Level.lean#L53-L59
    53  /-- The value of a level under a *valuation* `φ` of its parameters. -/
    54  def eval (φ : Name → Nat) : Level → Nat
    55    | zero => 0
    56    | succ l => eval φ l + 1
    57    | max a b => Max.max (eval φ a) (eval φ b)
    58    | imax a b => imaxNat (eval φ a) (eval φ b)
    59    | param n => φ n

== ConLeche/Verify/Level.lean#L26-L31
    26  @[expose] def eval (φ : Name → Nat) : Level → Nat
    27    | .zero => 0
    28    | .succ l => eval φ l + 1
    29    | .max l r => Max.max (eval φ l) (eval φ r)
    30    | .imax l r => if eval φ r = 0 then 0 else Max.max (eval φ l) (eval φ r)
    31    | .param n => φ n

== whitepaper/Fragment/Level.lean#L133-L146
   133  /-- **The level oracle** — the checker's decision procedures for `≤` and
   134  `=` on levels, assumed sound and complete with respect to `eval`: a
   135  parameter of the development, never defined here.  (`le` is what the
   136  inductive installs of the environment section consume; the env-free
   137  fragment uses `eq` alone.) -/
   138  class LevelOracle where
   139    /-- `le u v = true` decides `u ≤ v` at every valuation. -/
   140    le : Level → Level → Bool
   141    /-- `eq u v = true` decides `u = v` at every valuation. -/
   142    eq : Level → Level → Bool
   143    /-- Soundness and completeness of `le`. -/
   144    le_iff : ∀ a b : Level, le a b = true ↔ ∀ φ : Name → Nat, Level.eval φ a ≤ Level.eval φ b
   145    /-- Soundness and completeness of `eq`. -/
   146    eq_iff : ∀ a b : Level, eq a b = true ↔ ∀ φ : Name → Nat, Level.eval φ a = Level.eval φ b

== ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean#L143-L145
   143  /-- Decide `l ≤ r` semantically; `none` is an exhausted comparison. -/
   144  def leq (l r : Level) : Option Bool :=
   145    leqCore defaultFuel (simplify l) (simplify r) 0

== ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean#L163-L166
   163  def isEquiv (l r : Level) : Option Bool := do
   164    if l == r then pure true
   165    else if simplify l = simplify r then pure true
   166    else if ← leq l r then leq r l else pure false

== whitepaper/Fragment/PropWhen.lean#L208-L212
   208  /-- The conjunction of two data: a proposition when both are. -/
   209  def inter : PropWhen → PropWhen → PropWhen
   210    | never, _ => never
   211    | _, never => never
   212    | whenZero s, whenZero t => whenZero (s.union t)

== ConLeche/Kernel/PropWhen.lean#L860

== whitepaper/Fragment/PropWhen.lean#L279-L302
   279  /-- **The zero-ness datum of a level**: the reading of `{φ | eval φ l = 0}`.
   280  A `succ` is never zero; a `max` is zero when both sides are; an `imax`
   281  is zero exactly when its second argument is (`imaxNat_eq_zero_iff`).
   282  Mirrors `Level.zeronessOf` (`ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean`). -/
   283  def zeroness : Level → PropWhen
   284    | zero => .always
   285    | succ _ => .never
   286    | param n => .whenZero (ParamSet.single n)
   287    | max a b => (zeroness a).inter (zeroness b)
   288    | imax _ b => zeroness b
   289  
   290  /-- **Exactness**: the datum reads `true` exactly where the level
   291  evaluates to zero. -/
   292  theorem holds_zeroness (φ : Name → Nat) : ∀ l : Level,
   293      (zeroness l).holds φ = true ↔ eval φ l = 0
   294    | zero => by simp [zeroness]
   295    | succ l => by simp [zeroness]
   296    | param n => by simp [zeroness, PropWhen.holds_whenZero]
   297    | max a b => by
   298      simp only [zeroness, PropWhen.holds_inter, Bool.and_eq_true, holds_zeroness φ a,
   299        holds_zeroness φ b, eval_max]
   300      omega
   301    | imax a b => by
   302      simp only [zeroness, holds_zeroness φ b, eval_imax, imaxNat_eq_zero_iff]

== ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean#L191-L196
   191  def zeronessOf : Level → PropWhen
   192    | .zero => .ifAllZero []
   193    | .succ _ => .never
   194    | .param n => .ifAllZero [n]
   195    | .max a b => (zeronessOf a).inter (zeronessOf b)
   196    | .imax _ b => zeronessOf b

== ConLeche/Verify/PropWhen.lean#L52-L53
    52  theorem zeronessOf_sound (φ : Name → Nat) :
    53      ∀ l : Level, (Level.zeronessOf l).holds φ = (Level.eval φ l == 0)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L46-L339
    46  mutual
    47  
    48  /-- **Reduction**: the head steps of the checker's `whnf`, chained. -/
    49  inductive Red (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
    50    /-- No step (`Red.refl`, `Rel.lean:101`). -/
    51    | refl {Γ : List Expr} {e : Expr} : Red env Γ e e
    52    /-- Chaining (`Red.trans`, `Rel.lean:106`).  A reduction is a
    53    denotation identity, so chaining costs nothing semantically. -/
    54    | trans {Γ : List Expr} {e₁ e₂ e₃ : Expr} :
    55        Red env Γ e₁ e₂ → Red env Γ e₂ e₃ → Red env Γ e₁ e₃
    56    /-- Head reduction inside an application (`Red.appFn`,
    57    `Rel.lean:111`): the head is reduced before a redex is looked for. -/
    58    | appFn {Γ : List Expr} {f f' a : Expr} :
    59        Red env Γ f f' → Red env Γ (app f a) (app f' a)
    60    /-- **β at a fired gate** (`Red.betaGate`, `Rel.lean:121`): a λ whose
    61    annotation is `never` — its body is never a proposition — reduces
    62    with NO certificate.  The soundness of this step is the *graph
    63    regime*'s β: an application that is well-denoted applies a graph to
    64    a member of its domain, and a graph determines its domain
    65    (`Sound.lean`, `red_sound`'s `betaGate` case). -/
    66    | betaGate {Γ : List Expr} {A b a : Expr} :
    67        Red env Γ (app (lam A .never b) a) (b.inst a)
    68    /-- **β, certified** (`Red.beta`, `Rel.lean:126`): at any annotation,
    69    the argument's inferred type is definitionally equal to the domain.
    70    This is the check the real checker runs where the body may be a
    71    proposition, because then the model cannot recover the domain from
    72    the function's value (DESIGN.md, "Beta soundness without subject
    73    reduction"). -/
    74    | beta {Γ : List Expr} {A b a ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
    75        Infer env Γ a ta → DefEq env Γ ta A →
    76        Red env Γ (app (lam A pw b) a) (b.inst a)
    77    /-- **δ** (`Red.delta`, `Rel.lean:132`): a definition unfolds to its
    78    value, at the use's level instantiation.  (With `appFn`, an applied
    79    definition unfolds at its head.) -/
    80    | delta {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {ls : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo} {v : Expr} :
    81        env.find? c = some ci → ci.value? = some v →
    82        ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
    83        Red env Γ (const c ls) (v.instL ci.lparams ls)
    84    /-- **ι** (`Red.iota`, `Rel.lean:184`): a stored recursor applied to
    85    exactly its telescope — `numParams` parameters, `numMotives` motives,
    86    `numMinors` minor premises, `numIndices` indices and the major
    87    premise — whose major reduces to a constructor application with a
    88    rule, fires the rule: the rule's right-hand side, at the use's
    89    levels, applied to the parameters, motives and minors, then to the
    90    constructor's fields (its arguments after the parameters).  The rule
    91    is one of the block's own constructors' (no stored instantiation,
    92    `RecRule.inst`); an auxiliary recursor's rule fires by
    93    `Red.iotaNested`.
    94  
    95    The two **telescope certificates** are `Rel.lean`'s `Certs` walks
    96    (`:576-587`) folded in: the recursor's argument spine (with the
    97    reduced major) and the constructor's argument spine are each typed
    98    against the stored type's `Π`-telescope — every argument's type is
    99    inferred and found definitionally equal to the binder domain it
   100    meets (`Expr.piDomains`), and the stored type has the spine's
   101    length of syntactic binders (`Expr.hasPis`; a generated type does).
   102    They are what makes the environment's ι law (`EnvModel.lean`,
   103    `RecRuleLaw`) applicable: they put every argument in its domain.
   104  
   105    The **three comparisons** after them are `Rel.lean`'s too
   106    (`:206-231`): the constructor's levels are the recursor's (its last
   107    `usj.length` ones — a large eliminator carries one extra level in
   108    front), the constructor's parameters are definitionally the
   109    recursor's, and the constructor's residual type
   110    (`Expr.piResidual`: the family at the constructor's own parameters
   111    and index expressions, with the fields substituted in) has index
   112    expressions definitionally equal to the recursor's index arguments.
   113    In the model they matter exactly when the family is a proposition:
   114    there the major denotes the one point, the certificates say only
   115    that the fibre is inhabited, and the fields the rule's right-hand
   116    side receives can be related to the recursor's own parameters and
   117    indices through these comparisons alone (`Install.lean`). -/
   118    | iota {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {us : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo}
   119        {numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat} {rules : List RecRule}
   120        {args : List Expr} {major : Expr} {cj : Name} {usj : List Level}
   121        {cij : ConstInfo} {margs : List Expr} {rl : RecRule}
   122        {doms tys doms' tys' : List Expr}
   123        {residual : Expr} {I : Name} {lsI : List Level} {rps ridx : List Expr} :
   124        env.find? c = some ci →
   125        ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   126        us.length = ci.lparams.length →
   127        args.length = numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices + 1 →
   128        ci.type.hasPis (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices + 1) = true →
   129        Red env Γ (args.getD (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) (bvar 0))
   130          major →
   131        major = mkAppN (const cj usj) margs →
   132        rl ∈ rules → rl.ctor = cj → rl.inst = none →
   133        env.find? cj = some cij →
   134        usj.length = cij.lparams.length →
   135        margs.length = numParams + rl.nfields →
   136        cij.type.hasPis (numParams + rl.nfields) = true →
   137        -- the recursor's telescope certificate, on the spine with the reduced major
   138        piDomains (ci.type.instL ci.lparams us)
   139          (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) ++ [major]) = some doms →
   140        tys.length = doms.length →
   141        (∀ p ∈ (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) ++ [major]).zip tys,
   142          Infer env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   143        (∀ p ∈ tys.zip doms, DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   144        -- the constructor's telescope certificate
   145        piDomains (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) margs = some doms' →
   146        tys'.length = doms'.length →
   147        (∀ p ∈ margs.zip tys', Infer env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   148        (∀ p ∈ tys'.zip doms', DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   149        -- the constructor's levels, parameters and residual indices against the recursor's
   150        Level.eqList usj (us.drop (us.length - usj.length)) = true →
   151        (∀ p ∈ (margs.take numParams).zip (args.take numParams), DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   152        piResidual (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) margs = some residual →
   153        residual = mkAppN (const I lsI) (rps ++ ridx) →
   154        rps.length = numParams →
   155        (∀ p ∈ ridx.zip ((args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices)).drop
   156          (numParams + numMotives + numMinors)), DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   157        Red env Γ (mkAppN (const c us) args)
   158          (mkAppN (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us)
   159            (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors) ++ margs.drop numParams))
   160    /-- **ι, nested** (con-leche's `.nested`-certified rules, task #48):
   161    a rule of an auxiliary recursor fires on a constructor of the
   162    block's *container*, whose parameters are not the recursor's.  The
   163    rule stores the constructor's expected levels (over the recursor's
   164    level parameters) and expected parameters (terms under the
   165    recursor's parameter binders, `RecRule.inst`); the three
   166    comparisons of `Red.iota` become: the constructor's levels are the
   167    stored ones at the use's levels, its parameters are definitionally
   168    the stored ones at the recursor's parameter arguments
   169    (`Expr.instChain`), and the residual's index expressions are
   170    definitionally the recursor's index arguments.  The constructor's
   171    own parameter count comes from its record.  The telescope
   172    certificates are as in `Red.iota`. -/
   173    | iotaNested {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {us : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo}
   174        {numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat} {rules : List RecRule}
   175        {args : List Expr} {major : Expr} {cj : Name} {usj : List Level}
   176        {cij : ConstInfo} {I' : Name} {nPc nfj : Nat} {margs : List Expr} {rl : RecRule}
   177        {lvs : List Level} {pinst : List Expr}
   178        {doms tys doms' tys' : List Expr}
   179        {residual : Expr} {I : Name} {lsI : List Level} {rps ridx : List Expr} :
   180        env.find? c = some ci →
   181        ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   182        us.length = ci.lparams.length →
   183        args.length = numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices + 1 →
   184        ci.type.hasPis (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices + 1) = true →
   185        Red env Γ (args.getD (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) (bvar 0))
   186          major →
   187        major = mkAppN (const cj usj) margs →
   188        rl ∈ rules → rl.ctor = cj → rl.inst = some (lvs, pinst) →
   189        env.find? cj = some cij →
   190        cij.kind = .ctor I' nPc nfj →
   191        usj.length = cij.lparams.length →
   192        margs.length = nPc + rl.nfields →
   193        cij.type.hasPis (nPc + rl.nfields) = true →
   194        piDomains (ci.type.instL ci.lparams us)
   195          (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) ++ [major]) = some doms →
   196        tys.length = doms.length →
   197        (∀ p ∈ (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) ++ [major]).zip tys,
   198          Infer env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   199        (∀ p ∈ tys.zip doms, DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   200        piDomains (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) margs = some doms' →
   201        tys'.length = doms'.length →
   202        (∀ p ∈ margs.zip tys', Infer env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   203        (∀ p ∈ tys'.zip doms', DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   204        -- the constructor's levels and parameters against the stored instantiation
   205        Level.eqList usj (lvs.map (Level.subst ci.lparams us)) = true →
   206        pinst.length = nPc →
   207        (∀ p ∈ (margs.take nPc).zip
   208          (pinst.map fun e => instChain (e.instL ci.lparams us) (args.take numParams)),
   209          DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   210        piResidual (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) margs = some residual →
   211        residual = mkAppN (const I lsI) (rps ++ ridx) →
   212        rps.length = nPc →
   213        (∀ p ∈ ridx.zip ((args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices)).drop
   214          (numParams + numMotives + numMinors)), DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   215        Red env Γ (mkAppN (const c us) args)
   216          (mkAppN (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us)
   217            (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors) ++ margs.drop nPc))
   218  
   219  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of the checker's
   220  `isDefEq`.
   221  
   222  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately** (`Rel.lean:310-333`, task
   223  #309).  The relation is the checker's verdict on two terms that are
   224  well-formed *together*, a fact no rule states because well-formedness
   225  is semantic (`WellDenoted`) and may not enter this inductive.  Every
   226  rule respects one discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq`
   227  premise is a subterm of the conclusion or is produced by a `Red` or
   228  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   229  always has the premise's terms — and their invariant — in hand.  A
   230  `trans` rule is the unique rule that would break it: its middle term
   231  comes from nowhere, so nothing supplies its invariant, and the
   232  induction has nothing to apply the hypothesis to.  In the real checker
   233  the rule is not merely unprovable but unsound (`fvar`s carry
   234  annotations `DefEq.fvar` does not compare while `DefEq.proofFast`
   235  reads; `trans` lets the two meet).  The one sound chaining is "reduce,
   236  then continue": `redL`. -/
   237  inductive DefEq (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   238    /-- The syntactic fast path (`DefEq.refl`, `Rel.lean:338`). -/
   239    | refl {Γ : List Expr} {a : Expr} : DefEq env Γ a a
   240    /-- Symmetry (`DefEq.symm`, `Rel.lean:341`).  Not a checker move: the
   241    constructor from which every right-hand variant of a one-sided rule
   242    is derived. -/
   243    | symm {Γ : List Expr} {a b : Expr} : DefEq env Γ a b → DefEq env Γ b a
   244    /-- **Reduce the left side, then continue** (`DefEq.redL`,
   245    `Rel.lean:346`): the recursive structure of `isDefEq` — head
   246    normalisation of either side (with `symm`) and every lazy-δ
   247    continuation. -/
   248    | redL {Γ : List Expr} {a a' b : Expr} :
   249        Red env Γ a a' → DefEq env Γ a' b → DefEq env Γ a b
   250    /-- Two sorts, by the level oracle (`DefEq.sort`, `Rel.lean:349`). -/
   251    | sort {Γ : List Expr} {u v : Level} :
   252        LevelOracle.eq u v = true → DefEq env Γ (sort u) (sort v)
   253    /-- Two constants of the same name at oracle-equal levels
   254    (`DefEq.const`, `Rel.lean:360`). -/
   255    | const {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {ls ls' : List Level} :
   256        Level.eqList ls ls' = true → DefEq env Γ (const c ls) (const c ls')
   257    /-- `∀`-congruence (`DefEq.forallE`, `Rel.lean:373`): domains, then
   258    bodies under the RIGHT domain, and the annotations must agree (they
   259    are compared with `=`, which is semantic: `PropWhen.eq_iff`). -/
   260    | pi {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   261        DefEq env Γ A₁ A₂ → DefEq env (A₂ :: Γ) B₁ B₂ →
   262        DefEq env Γ (pi A₁ pw B₁) (pi A₂ pw B₂)
   263    /-- λ-congruence (`DefEq.lam`, `Rel.lean:380`), as for `∀`. -/
   264    | lam {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ A₂ b₂ : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   265        DefEq env Γ A₁ A₂ → DefEq env (A₂ :: Γ) b₁ b₂ →
   266        DefEq env Γ (lam A₁ pw b₁) (lam A₂ pw b₂)
   267    /-- Application congruence (`DefEq.app`, `Rel.lean:390`). -/
   268    | app {Γ : List Expr} {f₁ a₁ f₂ a₂ : Expr} :
   269        DefEq env Γ f₁ f₂ → DefEq env Γ a₁ a₂ →
   270        DefEq env Γ (app f₁ a₁) (app f₂ a₂)
   271    /-- **η** (`DefEq.eta`, `Rel.lean:400`): a λ against a term `b`
   272    whose inferred type reduces to a `∀` with a definitionally equal
   273    domain and the same annotation, when the λ's body is `b` applied to
   274    the variable.  Sound because a member of a function space is the
   275    abstraction of its applications (`SetLib.graph_app_eq`) — and at a
   276    proposition both sides are the one proof. -/
   277    | eta {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ b tb A₂ B : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   278        Infer env Γ b tb → Red env Γ tb (pi A₂ pw B) →
   279        DefEq env Γ A₂ A₁ →
   280        DefEq env (A₁ :: Γ) b₁ (app (b.liftN 1) (bvar 0)) →
   281        DefEq env Γ (lam A₁ pw b₁) b
   282    /-- **Proof irrelevance** (`DefEq.proofIrrel`, `Rel.lean:417`): both
   283    sides' inferred types have sort `Prop`.  **The two types are never
   284    compared**: the model justifies that, because every proof denotes the
   285    one point. -/
   286    | proofIrrel {Γ : List Expr} {a ta tta b tb ttb : Expr} {u v : Level} :
   287        Infer env Γ a ta → Infer env Γ ta tta → Red env Γ tta (sort u) →
   288        LevelOracle.eq u .zero = true →
   289        Infer env Γ b tb → Infer env Γ tb ttb → Red env Γ ttb (sort v) →
   290        LevelOracle.eq v .zero = true →
   291        DefEq env Γ a b
   292  
   293  /-- **Type inference.** -/
   294  inductive Infer (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   295    /-- A bound variable's type is its context entry, lifted over the
   296    binders in between (`Infer.fvar`, `Rel.lean:492`; the real checker
   297    reads the type off the free variable). -/
   298    | bvar {Γ : List Expr} {i : Nat} {A : Expr} :
   299        Γ[i]? = some A → Infer env Γ (bvar i) (A.liftN (i + 1))
   300    /-- `Sort u : Sort (u + 1)` (`Infer.sort`, `Rel.lean:488`). -/
   301    | sort {Γ : List Expr} {u : Level} :
   302        Infer env Γ (sort u) (sort (.succ u))
   303    /-- A stored constant at the right number of levels has its
   304    declared type, instantiated (`Infer.const`, `Rel.lean:496`). -/
   305    | const {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {ls : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo} :
   306        env.find? c = some ci → ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
   307        Infer env Γ (const c ls) (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls)
   308    /-- **`∀`-formation** (`Infer.forallE`, `Rel.lean:515`): the domain's
   309    type reduces to a sort `u`, the body's type (under the domain)
   310    reduces to a sort `v`, the result is `Sort (imax u v)` — and **the
   311    annotation is checked**: it must be the zero-ness datum of `v`. -/
   312    | pi {Γ : List Expr} {A B s t : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen} :
   313        Infer env Γ A s → Red env Γ s (sort u) →
   314        Infer env (A :: Γ) B t → Red env (A :: Γ) t (sort v) →
   315        Level.zeroness v = pw →
   316        Infer env Γ (pi A pw B) (sort (.imax u v))
   317    /-- **λ** (`Infer.lam`, `Rel.lean:530`): the domain's type reduces to
   318    a sort, the body is inferred under the domain, the body's type has a
   319    sort `v`, and **the annotation is checked** against `v`.  (The real
   320    checker validates the datum once per λ-chain; the fragment does it
   321    at every λ.) -/
   322    | lam {Γ : List Expr} {A b s bt btt : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen} :
   323        Infer env Γ A s → Red env Γ s (sort u) →
   324        Infer env (A :: Γ) b bt →
   325        Infer env (A :: Γ) bt btt → Red env (A :: Γ) btt (sort v) →
   326        Level.zeroness v = pw →
   327        Infer env Γ (lam A pw b) (pi A pw bt)
   328    /-- **Application** (`Infer.app`, `Rel.lean:544`): the head's type
   329    reduces to a `∀`, and the argument's inferred type is definitionally
   330    equal to its domain.  This is where a syntactic proof would need
   331    Π-injectivity and the semantic one does not: the `∀` the head's type
   332    reduces to *is* a function space, and membership in it is what the
   333    model needs (`Sound.lean`, `infer_sound`'s `app` case). -/
   334    | app {Γ : List Expr} {f a tf A B ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   335        Infer env Γ f tf → Red env Γ tf (pi A pw B) →
   336        Infer env Γ a ta → DefEq env Γ ta A →
   337        Infer env Γ (app f a) (B.inst a)
   338  
   339  end

    94  /-- **Reduction**: the head steps of `whnfCore` and the `whnf` loop,
    95  chained. -/
    96  inductive Red (env : Env) : Nat → Expr → Expr → Prop where

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L48-L59
    48  /-- **Reduction**: the head steps of the checker's `whnf`, chained. -/
    49  inductive Red (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
    50    /-- No step (`Red.refl`, `Rel.lean:101`). -/
    51    | refl {Γ : List Expr} {e : Expr} : Red env Γ e e
    52    /-- Chaining (`Red.trans`, `Rel.lean:106`).  A reduction is a
    53    denotation identity, so chaining costs nothing semantically. -/
    54    | trans {Γ : List Expr} {e₁ e₂ e₃ : Expr} :
    55        Red env Γ e₁ e₂ → Red env Γ e₂ e₃ → Red env Γ e₁ e₃
    56    /-- Head reduction inside an application (`Red.appFn`,
    57    `Rel.lean:111`): the head is reduced before a redex is looked for. -/
    58    | appFn {Γ : List Expr} {f f' a : Expr} :
    59        Red env Γ f f' → Red env Γ (app f a) (app f' a)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L96-L112
    96  inductive Red (env : Env) : Nat → Expr → Expr → Prop where
    97    /-- Every `pure e` exit: the value clauses of `whnfCoreBody`
    98    (`Kernel/Core.lean`), the stuck fallbacks (`:1003`, `:1033-1035`),
    99    an uncertified redex (`:1001`), `iotaRec = none` (`:1003`), the
   100    loop's fixpoint (`whnfStep`'s `pure e₁`, `:1088`). -/
   101    | refl {d : Nat} {e : Expr} : Red env d e e
   102    /-- The recursive `whnfCore` continuations after β/ι/proj
   103    (`Core.lean:990`, `:997`, `:1002`, `:1033`), the `whnf` loop
   104    (`whnfLoop`, `:1091-1095`), and the major's preparation chain
   105    (`prepareMajor`, `:785-807`). -/
   106    | trans {d : Nat} {e₁ e₂ e₃ : Expr} :
   107        Red env d e₁ e₂ → Red env d e₂ e₃ → Red env d e₁ e₃
   108    /-- Head normalisation inside an application (`whnfCoreBody`'s
   109    `.app` clause, `Kernel/Core.lean`: `whnfCore f` before the redex
   110    tests). -/
   111    | appFn {d : Nat} {f f' a : Expr} :
   112        Red env d f f' → Red env d (.app f a) (.app f' a)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L60-L76
    60    /-- **β at a fired gate** (`Red.betaGate`, `Rel.lean:121`): a λ whose
    61    annotation is `never` — its body is never a proposition — reduces
    62    with NO certificate.  The soundness of this step is the *graph
    63    regime*'s β: an application that is well-denoted applies a graph to
    64    a member of its domain, and a graph determines its domain
    65    (`Sound.lean`, `red_sound`'s `betaGate` case). -/
    66    | betaGate {Γ : List Expr} {A b a : Expr} :
    67        Red env Γ (app (lam A .never b) a) (b.inst a)
    68    /-- **β, certified** (`Red.beta`, `Rel.lean:126`): at any annotation,
    69    the argument's inferred type is definitionally equal to the domain.
    70    This is the check the real checker runs where the body may be a
    71    proposition, because then the model cannot recover the domain from
    72    the function's value (DESIGN.md, "Beta soundness without subject
    73    reduction"). -/
    74    | beta {Γ : List Expr} {A b a ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
    75        Infer env Γ a ta → DefEq env Γ ta A →
    76        Red env Γ (app (lam A pw b) a) (b.inst a)

   121    | betaGate {d : Nat} {ty body a : Expr} {mb : BinderMeta} :
   122        mb.pw.isNever = true →
   123        Red env d (.app (.lam ty body mb) a) (body.instantiate1 a)
   124    /-- **β, certified** (`Kernel/Core.lean`): the argument's io-grade
   125    type is definitionally equal to the domain. -/
   126    | beta {d : Nat} {ty body a ta : Expr} {mb : BinderMeta} :
   127        Infer env .io d a ta → DefEq env d ta ty →
   128        Red env d (.app (.lam ty body mb) a) (body.instantiate1 a)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L333-L361
   333  inductive DefEq (env : Env) : Nat → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   334    /-- The syntactic fast paths (`defeqStep`, `Core.lean:1463`, `:1472`),
   335    the literal leaf (`:1582`), a same-index `fvar` pair is `fvar`
   336    below. -/
   337    | refl {d : Nat} {a : Expr} : DefEq env d a a
   338    /-- Symmetry.  Not a checker move: the constructor from which every
   339    right-hand-side variant of a one-sided rule is derived. -/
   340    | symm {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} : DefEq env d a b → DefEq env d b a
   341    /-- **Reduce the left side, then continue** — the recursive-structure
   342    rule (ruling 1).  Covers `whnfCore` of both sides (`Kernel/Core.lean`,
   343    with `symm`), literal acceleration (`:1517-1529`), every lazy-delta
   344    continuation (`:1537-1577`), and the string-literal expansion. -/
   345    | redL {d : Nat} {a a' b : Expr} :
   346        Red env d a a' → DefEq env d a' b → DefEq env d a b
   347    /-- Two sorts (`Core.lean:1581`). -/
   348    | sort {d : Nat} {u v : Level} :
   349        Level.isEquiv u v = some true → DefEq env d (.sort u) (.sort v)
   350    /-- Two free variables of the same index (`Kernel/Core.lean`).  The
   351    annotations are NOT compared, as the checker does not compare them:
   352    at a well-formed call `CtxOk` pins every opened variable's
   353    annotation, so the reading ignores them.  This is one half of why
   354    the relation has no `trans` (see the inductive's docstring). -/
   355    | fvar {d i : Nat} {ty₁ ty₂ : Expr} :
   356        DefEq env d (.fvar i ty₁) (.fvar i ty₂)
   357    /-- Two constants of the same name at equivalent levels
   358    (`Kernel/Core.lean`). -/
   359    | const {d : Nat} {n : Name} {us us' : List Level} :
   360        Level.isEquivList us us' = some true →
   361        DefEq env d (.const n us) (.const n us')

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L257-L270
   257    /-- `∀`-congruence (`DefEq.forallE`, `Rel.lean:373`): domains, then
   258    bodies under the RIGHT domain, and the annotations must agree (they
   259    are compared with `=`, which is semantic: `PropWhen.eq_iff`). -/
   260    | pi {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   261        DefEq env Γ A₁ A₂ → DefEq env (A₂ :: Γ) B₁ B₂ →
   262        DefEq env Γ (pi A₁ pw B₁) (pi A₂ pw B₂)
   263    /-- λ-congruence (`DefEq.lam`, `Rel.lean:380`), as for `∀`. -/
   264    | lam {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ A₂ b₂ : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   265        DefEq env Γ A₁ A₂ → DefEq env (A₂ :: Γ) b₁ b₂ →
   266        DefEq env Γ (lam A₁ pw b₁) (lam A₂ pw b₂)
   267    /-- Application congruence (`DefEq.app`, `Rel.lean:390`). -/
   268    | app {Γ : List Expr} {f₁ a₁ f₂ a₂ : Expr} :
   269        DefEq env Γ f₁ f₂ → DefEq env Γ a₁ a₂ →
   270        DefEq env Γ (app f₁ a₁) (app f₂ a₂)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L372-L391
   372    | forallE {d : Nat} {ty₁ body₁ ty₂ body₂ : Expr} {m₁ m₂ : BinderMeta} :
   373        DefEq env d ty₁ ty₂ →
   374        DefEq env (d + 1) (body₁.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty₂))
   375          (body₂.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty₂)) →
   376        m₁.pw = m₂.pw →
   377        DefEq env d (.forallE ty₁ body₁ m₁) (.forallE ty₂ body₂ m₂)
   378    /-- λ-congruence (`Kernel/Core.lean`), as for ∀. -/
   379    | lam {d : Nat} {ty₁ body₁ ty₂ body₂ : Expr} {m₁ m₂ : BinderMeta} :
   380        DefEq env d ty₁ ty₂ →
   381        DefEq env (d + 1) (body₁.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty₂))
   382          (body₂.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty₂)) →
   383        m₁.pw = m₂.pw →
   384        DefEq env d (.lam ty₁ body₁ m₁) (.lam ty₂ body₂ m₂)
   385    /-- Per-node application congruence.  The checker's spine-wise
   386    congruence (`Kernel/Core.lean`) and the same-head short-circuit
   387    (`defeqSpine`, `:1426-1458`) are derived from it
   388    (`DefEq.spine`, `DefEq.constSpine`). -/
   389    | app {d : Nat} {f₁ a₁ f₂ a₂ : Expr} :
   390        DefEq env d f₁ f₂ → DefEq env d a₁ a₂ →
   391        DefEq env d (.app f₁ a₁) (.app f₂ a₂)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L271-L291
   271    /-- **η** (`DefEq.eta`, `Rel.lean:400`): a λ against a term `b`
   272    whose inferred type reduces to a `∀` with a definitionally equal
   273    domain and the same annotation, when the λ's body is `b` applied to
   274    the variable.  Sound because a member of a function space is the
   275    abstraction of its applications (`SetLib.graph_app_eq`) — and at a
   276    proposition both sides are the one proof. -/
   277    | eta {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ b tb A₂ B : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   278        Infer env Γ b tb → Red env Γ tb (pi A₂ pw B) →
   279        DefEq env Γ A₂ A₁ →
   280        DefEq env (A₁ :: Γ) b₁ (app (b.liftN 1) (bvar 0)) →
   281        DefEq env Γ (lam A₁ pw b₁) b
   282    /-- **Proof irrelevance** (`DefEq.proofIrrel`, `Rel.lean:417`): both
   283    sides' inferred types have sort `Prop`.  **The two types are never
   284    compared**: the model justifies that, because every proof denotes the
   285    one point. -/
   286    | proofIrrel {Γ : List Expr} {a ta tta b tb ttb : Expr} {u v : Level} :
   287        Infer env Γ a ta → Infer env Γ ta tta → Red env Γ tta (sort u) →
   288        LevelOracle.eq u .zero = true →
   289        Infer env Γ b tb → Infer env Γ tb ttb → Red env Γ ttb (sort v) →
   290        LevelOracle.eq v .zero = true →
   291        DefEq env Γ a b

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L399-L421
   399    | eta {d : Nat} {ty₁ body₁ b tb ty₂ B : Expr} {m₁ m₂ : BinderMeta} :
   400        Infer env .io d b tb → Red env d tb (.forallE ty₂ B m₂) →
   401        DefEq env d ty₂ ty₁ →
   402        DefEq env (d + 1) (body₁.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty₁))
   403          (.app b (.fvar d ty₁)) →
   404        m₁.pw = m₂.pw →
   405        DefEq env d (.lam ty₁ body₁ m₁) b
   406    /-- **The `isProofFast` yes-arm** (`propIrrel`, `Kernel/Core.lean`):
   407    both heads' validated data say "a proposition at every valuation" —
   408    the squash-regime licence (`prf_of_isProofFast`). -/
   409    | proofFast {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} :
   410        isProofFast env.find? a = true → isProofFast env.find? b = true →
   411        DefEq env d a b
   412    /-- **Proof irrelevance** (`propIrrel`'s slow arm, `Kernel/Core.lean`,
   413    and `proofIrrel`'s `Prop` arm, `:295-325`): both sides' io-inferred
   414    types have sort `Prop`.  The two types are never compared — the
   415    model licenses that (every proof is the point). -/
   416    | proofIrrel {d : Nat} {a ta tta b tb ttb : Expr} {u v : Level} :
   417        Infer env .io d a ta → Infer env .io d ta tta →
   418        Red env d tta (.sort u) → Level.isEquiv u .zero = some true →
   419        Infer env .io d b tb → Infer env .io d tb ttb →
   420        Red env d ttb (.sort v) → Level.isEquiv v .zero = some true →
   421        DefEq env d a b

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L219-L236
   219  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of the checker's
   220  `isDefEq`.
   221  
   222  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately** (`Rel.lean:310-333`, task
   223  #309).  The relation is the checker's verdict on two terms that are
   224  well-formed *together*, a fact no rule states because well-formedness
   225  is semantic (`WellDenoted`) and may not enter this inductive.  Every
   226  rule respects one discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq`
   227  premise is a subterm of the conclusion or is produced by a `Red` or
   228  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   229  always has the premise's terms — and their invariant — in hand.  A
   230  `trans` rule is the unique rule that would break it: its middle term
   231  comes from nowhere, so nothing supplies its invariant, and the
   232  induction has nothing to apply the hypothesis to.  In the real checker
   233  the rule is not merely unprovable but unsound (`fvar`s carry
   234  annotations `DefEq.fvar` does not compare while `DefEq.proofFast`
   235  reads; `trans` lets the two meet).  The one sound chaining is "reduce,
   236  then continue": `redL`. -/

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L309-L332
   309  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of `isDefEq`.
   310  
   311  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately, and none can be added**
   312  (task #309, the experiment recorded in DESIGN.md).  The relation is
   313  not an equivalence on terms: it is the checker's verdict, and the
   314  checker only ever compares terms that are well-formed *together* — a
   315  fact the rules never state, because well-formedness (scoping, the
   316  readability of annotations, the grading of the reading) is semantic
   317  and may not enter this inductive.  Every rule respects one syntactic
   318  discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq` premise is either a
   319  subterm of the conclusion or is produced by an existence-form `Red` /
   320  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   321  (`ConLeche/Model/Rules/Sound.lean`) always has the premise's terms in
   322  hand.  `trans` is the unique rule that would break it: its middle
   323  term comes from nowhere, and with it two rules that are each sound
   324  alone meet — `fvar` compares free variables by index only (their
   325  annotations are not compared, as the checker does not), while
   326  `proofFast` *reads* an annotation to decide "definitely a proof" —
   327  and derive `DefEq env d (.fvar i ty) (.fvar i' ty')` for every
   328  `i`, `i'`, which no model satisfies.  The recursive-structure rules
   329  (`redL`, `natSucc`, `eta`, `structUnit`) are therefore not a
   330  proof-engineering convenience but what keeps the relation sound; the
   331  one chaining that is sound, "reduce, then continue", is `redL`, and
   332  its right-hand and δ variants are derived in `Derived.lean`. -/

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L294-L307
   294  inductive Infer (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   295    /-- A bound variable's type is its context entry, lifted over the
   296    binders in between (`Infer.fvar`, `Rel.lean:492`; the real checker
   297    reads the type off the free variable). -/
   298    | bvar {Γ : List Expr} {i : Nat} {A : Expr} :
   299        Γ[i]? = some A → Infer env Γ (bvar i) (A.liftN (i + 1))
   300    /-- `Sort u : Sort (u + 1)` (`Infer.sort`, `Rel.lean:488`). -/
   301    | sort {Γ : List Expr} {u : Level} :
   302        Infer env Γ (sort u) (sort (.succ u))
   303    /-- A stored constant at the right number of levels has its
   304    declared type, instantiated (`Infer.const`, `Rel.lean:496`). -/
   305    | const {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {ls : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo} :
   306        env.find? c = some ci → ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
   307        Infer env Γ (const c ls) (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L479-L495
   479  inductive Infer (env : Env) : Grade → Nat → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   480    /-- `Core.lean:1114` / `:1294`. -/
   481    | sort {g : Grade} {d : Nat} {u : Level} :
   482        Infer env g d (.sort u) (.sort (.succ u))
   483    /-- `Kernel/Core.lean` / `:1295-1297`: an opened variable's stored
   484    type, at the leaf scope check. -/
   485    | fvar {g : Grade} {d idx : Nat} {ty : Expr} :
   486        idx < d → Infer env g d (.fvar idx ty) ty
   487    /-- `Kernel/Core.lean` / `:1298-1309`: a stored constant that is
   488    not a projection table, at the right level arity. -/
   489    | const {g : Grade} {d : Nat} {n : Name} {us : List Level}
   490        {ci : ConstantInfo} :
   491        env.find? n = some ci → ci.isTowerEntry = false →
   492        us.length = ci.toConstantVal.levelParams.length →
   493        Infer env g d (.const n us)
   494          (ci.toConstantVal.type.instantiateLevelParams
   495            ci.toConstantVal.levelParams us)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L308-L327
   308    /-- **`∀`-formation** (`Infer.forallE`, `Rel.lean:515`): the domain's
   309    type reduces to a sort `u`, the body's type (under the domain)
   310    reduces to a sort `v`, the result is `Sort (imax u v)` — and **the
   311    annotation is checked**: it must be the zero-ness datum of `v`. -/
   312    | pi {Γ : List Expr} {A B s t : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen} :
   313        Infer env Γ A s → Red env Γ s (sort u) →
   314        Infer env (A :: Γ) B t → Red env (A :: Γ) t (sort v) →
   315        Level.zeroness v = pw →
   316        Infer env Γ (pi A pw B) (sort (.imax u v))
   317    /-- **λ** (`Infer.lam`, `Rel.lean:530`): the domain's type reduces to
   318    a sort, the body is inferred under the domain, the body's type has a
   319    sort `v`, and **the annotation is checked** against `v`.  (The real
   320    checker validates the datum once per λ-chain; the fragment does it
   321    at every λ.) -/
   322    | lam {Γ : List Expr} {A b s bt btt : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen} :
   323        Infer env Γ A s → Red env Γ s (sort u) →
   324        Infer env (A :: Γ) b bt →
   325        Infer env (A :: Γ) bt btt → Red env (A :: Γ) btt (sort v) →
   326        Level.zeroness v = pw →
   327        Infer env Γ (lam A pw b) (pi A pw bt)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L508-L532
   508    | forallE {g : Grade} {d : Nat} {ty body s bs : Expr} {u v : Level}
   509        {mb : BinderMeta} :
   510        Infer env g d ty s → Red env d s (.sort u) →
   511        Infer env g (d + 1) (body.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty)) bs →
   512        Red env (d + 1) bs (.sort v) →
   513        Level.zeronessOf v = mb.pw →
   514        Infer env g d (.forallE ty body mb) (.sort (.imax u v))
   515    /-- **λ** (`Kernel/Core.lean` / `:1327-1348`).  At the full grade the
   516    domain's type reduces to a sort (`g = .full →`: official's
   517    `infer_lambda` skips it at `infer_only`, and so does the io body);
   518    the opened body is inferred at the grade; the codomain datum is
   519    validated once per λ-chain — at an inner λ by datum equality with
   520    the neighbour, at the innermost binder by the io-grade sort
   521    computation on the body type (`body.lamPw = none →`).  The `s u btt
   522    v` witnesses are junk where their premise is vacuous. -/
   523    | lam {g : Grade} {d : Nat} {ty body s bt btt : Expr} {u v : Level}
   524        {mb : BinderMeta} :
   525        (g = .full → Infer env .full d ty s) →
   526        (g = .full → Red env d s (.sort u)) →
   527        Infer env g (d + 1) (body.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty)) bt →
   528        (∀ pwI, body.lamPw = some pwI → mb.pw = pwI) →
   529        (body.lamPw = none → Infer env .io (d + 1) bt btt) →
   530        (body.lamPw = none → Red env (d + 1) btt (.sort v)) →
   531        (body.lamPw = none → Level.zeronessOf v = mb.pw) →
   532        Infer env g d (.lam ty body mb) (.forallE ty (bt.abstract1 d) mb)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L328-L337
   328    /-- **Application** (`Infer.app`, `Rel.lean:544`): the head's type
   329    reduces to a `∀`, and the argument's inferred type is definitionally
   330    equal to its domain.  This is where a syntactic proof would need
   331    Π-injectivity and the semantic one does not: the `∀` the head's type
   332    reduces to *is* a function space, and membership in it is what the
   333    model needs (`Sound.lean`, `infer_sound`'s `app` case). -/
   334    | app {Γ : List Expr} {f a tf A B ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   335        Infer env Γ f tf → Red env Γ tf (pi A pw B) →
   336        Infer env Γ a ta → DefEq env Γ ta A →
   337        Infer env Γ (app f a) (B.inst a)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L537-L540
   537    | app {g : Grade} {d : Nat} {f a tf ty body ta : Expr} {mt : BinderMeta} :
   538        Infer env g d f tf → Red env d tf (.forallE ty body mt) →
   539        Infer env g d a ta → DefEq env d ta ty →
   540        Infer env g d (.app f a) (body.instantiate1 a)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Lib.lean#L44-L99
    44  class SetLib (V : Type u) where
    45    /-- Membership. -/
    46    Mem : V → V → Prop
    47    /-- Extensionality. -/
    48    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
    49    /-- Separation: the members of `A` that satisfy `P`. -/
    50    sep : V → (V → Prop) → V
    51    /-- The members of a separation. -/
    52    mem_sep : ∀ {A : V} {P : V → Prop} {z : V}, Mem z (sep A P) ↔ Mem z A ∧ P z
    53    /-- A distinguished set; any set would do.  It is the one proof of
    54    every true proposition. -/
    55    pt : V
    56    /-- The one-element set `{pt}`. -/
    57    one : V
    58    /-- The members of `{pt}`. -/
    59    mem_one : ∀ {z : V}, Mem z one ↔ z = pt
    60    /-- The universe chain: `univ n` interprets `Sort n`. -/
    61    univ : Nat → V
    62    /-- `univ 0` is the set of subsets of `{pt}` — the truth values. -/
    63    mem_univ_zero : ∀ {T : V}, Mem T (univ 0) ↔ ∀ z, Mem z T → z = pt
    64    /-- Each universe is a member of the next. -/
    65    univ_mem_succ : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univ n) (univ (n + 1))
    66    /-- Cumulativity. -/
    67    univ_mono : ∀ {m n : Nat} {x : V}, m ≤ n → Mem x (univ m) → Mem x (univ n)
    68    /-- The graph of a function on a domain. -/
    69    graph : (V → V) → V → V
    70    /-- The dependent function space: the graphs over `A` with values
    71    in the fibres `B`. -/
    72    piSet : V → (V → V) → V
    73    /-- Application.  On the point it is the point (a proof applied to
    74    anything is a proof); on a graph it reads the graph. -/
    75    app : V → V → V
    76    /-- A proof applied is the proof. -/
    77    app_pt : ∀ a : V, app pt a = pt
    78    /-- β: a graph applied on its domain computes. -/
    79    app_graph : ∀ {F : V → V} {A a : V}, Mem a A → app (graph F A) a = F a
    80    /-- A graph is never the point. -/
    81    graph_ne_pt : ∀ {F : V → V} {A : V}, graph F A ≠ pt
    82    /-- A graph depends only on the function's values on the domain. -/
    83    graph_congr : ∀ {F F' : V → V} {A : V}, (∀ x, Mem x A → F x = F' x) → graph F A = graph F' A
    84    /-- A function space depends only on the fibres over the domain. -/
    85    piSet_congr : ∀ {A : V} {B B' : V → V}, (∀ x, Mem x A → B x = B' x) → piSet A B = piSet A B'
    86    /-- Introduction: fibre-wise members abstract into the space. -/
    87    graph_mem_piSet : ∀ {A : V} {F B : V → V},
    88      (∀ x, Mem x A → Mem (F x) (B x)) → Mem (graph F A) (piSet A B)
    89    /-- Elimination. -/
    90    app_mem_piSet : ∀ {A f a : V} {B : V → V}, Mem f (piSet A B) → Mem a A → Mem (app f a) (B a)
    91    /-- η: a member of a function space is the graph of its applications. -/
    92    graph_app_eq : ∀ {A f : V} {B : V → V}, Mem f (piSet A B) → graph (fun x => app f x) A = f
    93    /-- A graph determines its domain. -/
    94    piSet_dom_unique : ∀ {A A' f : V} {B B' : V → V},
    95      Mem f (piSet A B) → Mem f (piSet A' B') → A = A'
    96    /-- Closure of the positive universes under dependent function
    97    spaces. -/
    98    piSet_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {A : V} {B : V → V}, n ≠ 0 →
    99      Mem A (univ n) → (∀ x, Mem x A → Mem (B x) (univ n)) → Mem (piSet A B) (univ n)

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L100
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:

    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where

== whitepaper/Fragment/Lib.lean#L115-L121
   115  /-- The truth value of a proposition: `{pt}` if it holds, `∅` if
   116  not. -/
   117  def truthVal (P : Prop) : V := sep one (fun _ => P)
   118  
   119  /-- The members of a truth value. -/
   120  theorem mem_truthVal {p : Prop} {z : V} : z ∈ˢ truthVal p ↔ z = pt ∧ p := by
   121    unfold truthVal; rw [mem_sep, mem_one]

   250      piR true A B ∈ˢ (univ 0 : V) := truthVal_mem_univ_zero _

== whitepaper/Fragment/Interp.lean#L124-L130
   124  def interp (M : Name → List Nat → V) (φ : Name → Nat) : (Nat → V) → Expr → V
   125    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   126    | _, .sort u => univ (u.eval φ)
   127    | _, .const c ls => M c (ls.map (Level.eval φ))
   128    | ρ, .app f a => app (interp M φ ρ f) (interp M φ ρ a)
   129    | ρ, .lam A pw b => lamR (pw.holds φ) (interp M φ ρ A) fun x => interp M φ (cons x ρ) b
   130    | ρ, .pi A pw B => piR (pw.holds φ) (interp M φ ρ A) fun x => interp M φ (cons x ρ) B

== whitepaper/Fragment/PropWhen.lean#L191-L194
   191  def holds (pw : PropWhen) (φ : Name → Nat) : Bool :=
   192    match pw with
   193    | never => false
   194    | whenZero ps => ps.list.all fun n => φ n == 0

== whitepaper/Fragment/Lib.lean#L157-L163
   157  /-- **The propositional product** `Π₀(A, B)`: the truth value "every
   158  fibre is `{pt}`".  When the fibres are truth values it is their
   159  intersection `⋂ x ∈ A, B x` (the empty intersection being `{pt}`):
   160  `{pt}` exactly when every fibre is, `∅` otherwise — the product of
   161  subsets of a singleton.  Reducible, so proofs that unfold `piR true`
   162  keep working. -/
   163  abbrev piProp (A : V) (B : V → V) : V := truthVal (∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x = one)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Lib.lean#L167-L172
   167  def piR (p : Bool) (A : V) (B : V → V) : V :=
   168    if p then piProp A B else piSet A B
   169  
   170  /-- Abstraction at regime `p`: the point when `p`, the graph above it. -/
   171  def lamR (p : Bool) (A : V) (F : V → V) : V :=
   172    if p then pt else graph F A

== ConLeche/SetModel/Ops.lean#L56-L62
    56  noncomputable def piR (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V) : V :=
    57    if v = 0 then truthVal (∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → ∃ y, y ∈ˢ B x) else piSet A B
    58  
    59  /-- Abstraction at codomain sort `v`: the canonical proof at `0`, the
    60  literal function graph above it. -/
    61  noncomputable def lamR (v : Nat) (A : V) (F : V → V) : V :=
    62    if v = 0 then pt else graph F A

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L150-L156
   150  noncomputable def interp : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → V
   151    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   152    | _, .sort u => univ u
   153    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   154    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)
   155    | ρ, .lam v A b => lamR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) b
   156    | ρ, .pi _ v A B => piR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B

== whitepaper/Fragment/WellDenoted.lean#L62-L119
    62  inductive WellDenoted (M : Name → List Nat → V) (φ : Name → Nat) : (Nat → V) → Expr → Prop
    63    /-- A variable is always well-denoted: it denotes whatever `ρ` holds. -/
    64    | bvar {ρ : Nat → V} {i : Nat} : WellDenoted M φ ρ (.bvar i)
    65    /-- A sort is always well-denoted: it denotes a universe. -/
    66    | sort {ρ : Nat → V} {u : Level} : WellDenoted M φ ρ (.sort u)
    67    /-- A constant is always well-denoted: it denotes what the model `M` says. -/
    68    | const {ρ : Nat → V} {c : Name} {ls : List Level} : WellDenoted M φ ρ (.const c ls)
    69    /-- **Application, function regime**: both parts are well-denoted, the
    70    function denotes a member of some function space `piSet A B`, and the
    71    argument a member of its domain `A`. -/
    72    | appFun {ρ : Nat → V} {f a : Expr} {A : V} {B : V → V} :
    73        WellDenoted M φ ρ f → WellDenoted M φ ρ a →
    74        interp M φ ρ f ∈ˢ piSet A B → interp M φ ρ a ∈ˢ A →
    75        WellDenoted M φ ρ (.app f a)
    76    /-- **Application, propositional regime**: both parts are well-denoted,
    77    the function denotes a member of the propositional product `piProp A B`
    78    — the truth value of "every fibre is `{pt}`" — the argument a member
    79    of `A`, and the fibres are truth values. -/
    80    | appProp {ρ : Nat → V} {f a : Expr} {A : V} {B : V → V} :
    81        WellDenoted M φ ρ f → WellDenoted M φ ρ a →
    82        interp M φ ρ f ∈ˢ piProp A B → interp M φ ρ a ∈ˢ A →
    83        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ univ 0) →
    84        WellDenoted M φ ρ (.app f a)
    85    /-- **λ, function regime** (the annotation does not hold): the domain is
    86    well-denoted, the body is well-denoted under every value of the
    87    domain, and its value lies in `B x` for every such `x` — some fibre
    88    family `B` bounds the body. -/
    89    | lamFun {ρ : Nat → V} {A : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} {b : Expr} {B : V → V} :
    90        pw.holds φ = false →
    91        WellDenoted M φ ρ A →
    92        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → WellDenoted M φ (cons x ρ) b) →
    93        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → interp M φ (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) →
    94        WellDenoted M φ ρ (.lam A pw b)
    95    /-- **λ, propositional regime** (the annotation holds): as `lamFun`, and
    96    the codomain's fibres `B x` are truth values. -/
    97    | lamProp {ρ : Nat → V} {A : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} {b : Expr} {B : V → V} :
    98        pw.holds φ = true →
    99        WellDenoted M φ ρ A →
   100        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → WellDenoted M φ (cons x ρ) b) →
   101        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → interp M φ (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) →
   102        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → B x ∈ˢ univ 0) →
   103        WellDenoted M φ ρ (.lam A pw b)
   104    /-- **∀, function regime** (the annotation does not hold): the domain is
   105    well-denoted and the body is well-denoted under every value of the
   106    domain. -/
   107    | piFun {ρ : Nat → V} {A : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} {B : Expr} :
   108        pw.holds φ = false →
   109        WellDenoted M φ ρ A →
   110        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → WellDenoted M φ (cons x ρ) B) →
   111        WellDenoted M φ ρ (.pi A pw B)
   112    /-- **∀, propositional regime** (the annotation holds): as `piFun`, and
   113    the body denotes a truth value at every value of the domain. -/
   114    | piProp {ρ : Nat → V} {A : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} {B : Expr} :
   115        pw.holds φ = true →
   116        WellDenoted M φ ρ A →
   117        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → WellDenoted M φ (cons x ρ) B) →
   118        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → interp M φ (cons x ρ) B ∈ˢ univ 0) →
   119        WellDenoted M φ ρ (.pi A pw B)

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L56-L70
    56  def WellDenoted : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → Prop
    57    | ρ, .pi _u _v A B =>
    58      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    59      ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) B
    60    | ρ, .lam v A b =>
    61      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    62      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) b) ∧
    63      ∃ B : V → V,
    64        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → interp V (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) ∧
    65        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))
    66    | ρ, .app f a =>
    67      WellDenoted ρ f ∧ WellDenoted ρ a ∧
    68      ∃ (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V),
    69        interp V ρ f ∈ˢ piR v A B ∧ interp V ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
    70        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))

   425  theorem WellDenoted_inst0 {e a : Expr} {ρ : Nat → V} (ha : WellDenoted M φ ρ a) :
   426      WellDenoted M φ ρ (e.inst a) ↔
   427        WellDenoted M φ (cons (interp M φ ρ a) ρ) e := by
   428    have h := WellDenoted_inst M φ e a 0 ρ (by rwa [shiftE_zero_zero])
   429    rwa [shiftE_zero_zero, instE_zero] at h

== whitepaper/Fragment/WellDenoted.lean#L529-L534
   529  def Sat (M : Name → List Nat → V) (φ : Name → Nat) : List Expr → (Nat → V) → Prop
   530    | [], _ => True
   531    | A :: Γ, ρ =>
   532      Sat M φ Γ (fun i => ρ (i + 1)) ∧
   533      WellDenoted M φ (fun i => ρ (i + 1)) A ∧
   534      ρ 0 ∈ˢ interp M φ (fun i => ρ (i + 1)) A

== whitepaper/Fragment/WellDenoted.lean#L469-L489
   469  theorem WellDenoted_beta_graph {A b a : Expr} {ρ : Nat → V}
   470      (h : WellDenoted M φ ρ (.app (.lam A .never b) a)) :
   471      interp M φ ρ (.app (.lam A .never b) a) = interp M φ ρ (b.inst a) ∧
   472      WellDenoted M φ ρ (b.inst a) := by
   473    rw [WellDenoted_app] at h
   474    obtain ⟨hlam, ha, p, A', B', hslot, hmem, -⟩ := h
   475    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at hlam
   476    obtain ⟨-, hbody, B, hfib, -⟩ := hlam
   477    -- the slot's product is in the graph regime: the λ is not the point
   478    have hp : p = false := by
   479      cases p
   480      · rfl
   481      · exact absurd (eq_pt_of_mem_piR_true hslot) lamR_false_ne_pt
   482    subst hp
   483    -- a graph determines its domain: the slot's domain is the λ's own
   484    have hown : interp M φ ρ (.lam A .never b) ∈ˢ piR false (interp M φ ρ A) B :=
   485      lamR_mem hfib fun h => nomatch h
   486    have hAA : interp M φ ρ A = A' := piR_dom_unique hown hslot
   487    have haA : interp M φ ρ a ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A := by rw [hAA]; exact hmem
   488    refine ⟨?_, (WellDenoted_inst0 M φ ha).mpr (hbody _ haA)⟩
   489    rw [interp_app, interp_lam, PropWhen.holds_never, app_lamR_false haA, interp_inst0]

   495  theorem WellDenoted_beta {A b a : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} {ρ : Nat → V}
   496      (h : WellDenoted M φ ρ (.app (.lam A pw b) a))
   497      (hmem : interp M φ ρ a ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A) :
   498      interp M φ ρ (.app (.lam A pw b) a) = interp M φ ρ (b.inst a) ∧
   499      WellDenoted M φ ρ (b.inst a) := by

   502    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at hlam

   504    refine ⟨?_, (WellDenoted_inst0 M φ ha).mpr (hbody _ hmem)⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L817-L821
   817  theorem soundness [LevelOracle] (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) :
   818      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e e' : Expr}, Red env Γ e e' → RedSem m φ Γ e e') ∧
   819      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {a b : Expr}, DefEq env Γ a b → DefEqSem m φ Γ a b) ∧
   820      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e T : Expr}, Infer env Γ e T → InferSem m φ Γ e T) :=
   821    ⟨red_sound, defeq_sound, infer_sound⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/Motive.lean#L40-L53
    40  def RedSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (e e' : Expr) : Prop :=
    41    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ e →
    42      WellDenoted m.M φ ρ e' ∧ interp m.M φ ρ e = interp m.M φ ρ e'
    43  
    44  /-- **`DefEq`'s claim**: equal denotations. -/
    45  def DefEqSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (a b : Expr) : Prop :=
    46    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ a → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ b →
    47      interp m.M φ ρ a = interp m.M φ ρ b
    48  
    49  /-- **`Infer`'s claim**: the term and its type are well-denoted, and
    50  the term's denotation is a member of the type's. -/
    51  def InferSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (e T : Expr) : Prop :=
    52    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ →
    53      WellDenoted m.M φ ρ e ∧ WellDenoted m.M φ ρ T ∧ interp m.M φ ρ e ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ T

== ConLeche/Model/Rules/Motive.lean#L70-L104
    70  @[expose] def RedSem {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat)
    71      (d : Nat) (e e' : Expr) : Prop :=
    72    Frame d e →
    73    ∀ {Δa : List AnnotTerm} {ea : AnnotTerm},
    74      CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
    75      denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    76      Graded V Δa ea →
    77      Frame d e' ∧ LeavesSub e' e ∧
    78        ∃ ea', denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' ∧
    79          Graded V Δa ea' ∧
    80          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
    81  
    82  /-- **`DefEq`'s motive**: `DefEqClaim`'s conclusion under its premises. -/
    83  @[expose] def DefEqSem {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat)
    84      (d : Nat) (a b : Expr) : Prop :=
    85    Frame d a → Frame d b →
    86    ∀ {Δa : List AnnotTerm} {aa ba : AnnotTerm},
    87      CtxOk m φ d Δa a → CtxOk m φ d Δa b →
    88      denoteMeta m.acval env φ d a = some aa →
    89      denoteMeta m.acval env φ d b = some ba →
    90      Graded V Δa aa → Graded V Δa ba →
    91      ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ aa = interp V ρ ba
    92  
    93  /-- **`Infer`'s motive at the full grade** — establishment: the
    94  subject's grading is a conclusion. -/
    95  @[expose] def InferSemFull {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat)
    96      (d : Nat) (e t : Expr) : Prop :=
    97    Frame d e →
    98    ∀ {Δa : List AnnotTerm} {ea : AnnotTerm},
    99      CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
   100      denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   101      Frame d t ∧ LeavesSub t e ∧
   102        ∃ ta, denoteMeta m.acval env φ d t = some ta ∧
   103          Graded V Δa ea ∧ Graded V Δa ta ∧
   104          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ∈ˢ interp V ρ ta

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L754-L807
   754  mutual
   755  
   756  /-- Every reduction is sound. -/
   757  theorem red_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e e' : Expr}, Red env Γ e e' → RedSem m φ Γ e e'
   758    | _, _, _, .refl => Red.refl_sound
   759    | _, _, _, .trans h₁ h₂ => Red.trans_sound (red_sound h₁) (red_sound h₂)
   760    | _, _, _, .appFn h => Red.appFn_sound (red_sound h)
   761    | _, _, _, .betaGate => Red.betaGate_sound
   762    | _, _, _, .beta hta hd => Red.beta_sound (infer_sound hta) (defeq_sound hd)
   763    | _, _, _, .delta hfind hv hls => Red.delta_sound hfind hv hls
   764    | _, _, _, .iota hfind hkind hus hlen hpis hmaj hmeq hrl hctor hinst hcij husj hmlen hpis' hdoms htys
   765        hI hD hdoms' htys' hI' hD' hlv hP hres hshape hrps hX =>
   766      Red.iota_sound rfl rfl hfind hkind hus hlen hpis (red_sound hmaj) hmeq hrl hctor hinst hcij husj
   767        hmlen hpis' hdoms htys (fun p hp => infer_sound (hI p hp)) (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hD p hp))
   768        hdoms' htys' (fun p hp => infer_sound (hI' p hp)) (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hD' p hp))
   769        hlv (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hP p hp)) hres hshape hrps
   770        (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hX p hp))
   771    | _, _, _, .iotaNested hfind hkind hus hlen hpis hmaj hmeq hrl hctor hinst hcij hcijk husj hmlen
   772        hpis' hdoms htys hI hD hdoms' htys' hI' hD' _ _ _ hres hshape hrps hX =>
   773      Red.iotaNested_sound rfl rfl hfind hkind hus hlen hpis (red_sound hmaj) hmeq hrl hctor hinst
   774        hcij hcijk husj hmlen hpis' hdoms htys (fun p hp => infer_sound (hI p hp))
   775        (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hD p hp)) hdoms' htys' (fun p hp => infer_sound (hI' p hp))
   776        (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hD' p hp)) hres hshape hrps (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hX p hp))
   777  
   778  /-- Every definitional-equality verdict is sound. -/
   779  theorem defeq_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {a b : Expr}, DefEq env Γ a b → DefEqSem m φ Γ a b
   780    | _, _, _, .refl => DefEq.refl_sound
   781    | _, _, _, .symm h => DefEq.symm_sound (defeq_sound h)
   782    | _, _, _, .redL hr h => DefEq.redL_sound (red_sound hr) (defeq_sound h)
   783    | _, _, _, .sort h => DefEq.sort_sound h
   784    | _, _, _, .const h => DefEq.const_sound h
   785    | _, _, _, .pi hA hB => DefEq.pi_sound (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hB)
   786    | _, _, _, .lam hA hb => DefEq.lam_sound (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hb)
   787    | _, _, _, .app hf ha => DefEq.app_sound (defeq_sound hf) (defeq_sound ha)
   788    | _, _, _, .eta htb hr hA hbody =>
   789      DefEq.eta_sound (infer_sound htb) (red_sound hr) (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hbody)
   790    | _, _, _, .proofIrrel hta htta hu hu0 htb httb hv hv0 =>
   791      DefEq.proofIrrel_sound (infer_sound hta) (infer_sound htta) (red_sound hu) hu0
   792        (infer_sound htb) (infer_sound httb) (red_sound hv) hv0
   793  
   794  /-- Every inference is sound. -/
   795  theorem infer_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e T : Expr}, Infer env Γ e T → InferSem m φ Γ e T
   796    | _, _, _, .bvar h => Infer.bvar_sound h
   797    | _, _, _, .sort => Infer.sort_sound
   798    | _, _, _, .const hfind hls => Infer.const_sound hfind hls
   799    | _, _, _, .pi hA hu hB hv hz =>
   800      Infer.pi_sound (infer_sound hA) (red_sound hu) (infer_sound hB) (red_sound hv) hz
   801    | _, _, _, .lam hA hu hb hbt hv hz =>
   802      Infer.lam_sound (infer_sound hA) (red_sound hu) (infer_sound hb) (infer_sound hbt)
   803        (red_sound hv) hz
   804    | _, _, _, .app hf hr ha hd =>
   805      Infer.app_sound (infer_sound hf) (red_sound hr) (infer_sound ha) (defeq_sound hd)
   806  
   807  end

   180  theorem beta_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A b a ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen}
   181      (hta : InferSem m φ Γ a ta) (hd : DefEqSem m φ Γ ta A) :
   182      RedSem m φ Γ (Expr.app (Expr.lam A pw b) a) (b.inst a) := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L501-L505
   501  theorem redL_sound {Γ : List Expr} {a a' b : Expr}
   502      (hr : RedSem m φ Γ a a') (h : DefEqSem m φ Γ a' b) : DefEqSem m φ Γ a b := by
   503    intro ρ hs ha hb
   504    obtain ⟨ha', he⟩ := hr ρ hs ha
   505    exact he.trans (h ρ hs ha' hb)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L556-L590
   556  theorem eta_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ b tb A₂ B : Expr} {pw : PropWhen}
   557      (htb : InferSem m φ Γ b tb) (hr : RedSem m φ Γ tb (Expr.pi A₂ pw B))
   558      (hA : DefEqSem m φ Γ A₂ A₁)
   559      (hbody : DefEqSem m φ (A₁ :: Γ) b₁ (Expr.app (b.liftN 1) (Expr.bvar 0))) :
   560      DefEqSem m φ Γ (Expr.lam A₁ pw b₁) b := by
   561    intro ρ hs hlam hwb
   562    -- `⟦b⟧` is a member of the product its type reduces to
   563    obtain ⟨-, hwtb, hmemb⟩ := htb ρ hs
   564    obtain ⟨hwpi, hepi⟩ := hr ρ hs hwtb
   565    rw [hepi, interp_pi] at hmemb
   566    rw [WellDenoted_pi] at hwpi
   567    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at hlam
   568    have heA : interp m.M φ ρ A₂ = interp m.M φ ρ A₁ := hA ρ hs hwpi.1 hlam.1
   569    -- the lifted `b` under the binder is `b`
   570    have hsh : ∀ x, shiftE 1 0 (cons x ρ) = ρ := by
   571      intro x; funext i; simp [shiftE]
   572    have hlift : ∀ x, interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) (b.liftN 1) = interp m.M φ ρ b := by
   573      intro x
   574      rw [interp_liftN, hsh]
   575    -- the body, pointwise, is `b` applied
   576    have hpt : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A₁ →
   577        interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) b₁ = SetLib.app (interp m.M φ ρ b) x := by
   578      intro x hx
   579      have hx₂ : x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A₂ := by rw [heA]; exact hx
   580      have happ : WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) (Expr.app (b.liftN 1) (Expr.bvar 0)) := by
   581        rw [WellDenoted_app]
   582        refine ⟨(WellDenoted_liftN m.M φ 1 b 0 (cons x ρ)).mpr ?_, .bvar,
   583          pw.holds φ, interp m.M φ ρ A₂, fun y => interp m.M φ (cons y ρ) B, ?_, hx₂, hwpi.2.2⟩
   584        · rw [hsh]; exact hwb
   585        · rw [hlift]; exact hmemb
   586      have := hbody (cons x ρ) ((Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, hlam.1, hx⟩) (hlam.2.1 x hx) happ
   587      rw [this, interp_app, interp_bvar, cons_zero, hlift]
   588    -- η in the model
   589    rw [interp_lam, lamR_congr hpt, ← heA]
   590    exact lamR_eta hmemb

   200      DefEqSem m φ d (.lam ty₁ body₁ m₁) b := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L593-L613
   593  theorem eq_pt_of_prop [LevelOracle] {Γ : List Expr} {a ta tta : Expr} {u : Level}
   594      (hta : InferSem m φ Γ a ta) (htta : InferSem m φ Γ ta tta)
   595      (hu : RedSem m φ Γ tta (Expr.sort u)) (hu0 : LevelOracle.eq u .zero = true)
   596      (ρ : Nat → V) (hs : Sat m.M φ Γ ρ) : interp m.M φ ρ a = pt := by
   597    obtain ⟨-, hwta, hmem⟩ := hta ρ hs
   598    obtain ⟨-, hwtta, hmem₂⟩ := htta ρ hs
   599    obtain ⟨-, heq⟩ := hu ρ hs hwtta
   600    rw [heq, interp_sort, eval_eq_of_oracle hu0, Level.eval_zero] at hmem₂
   601    exact eq_pt_of_mem_univ_zero hmem₂ hmem
   602  
   603  /-- **Proof irrelevance is sound, for free.**  Each side's type has
   604  sort `Prop`, so each side's denotation is a member of a truth value,
   605  hence the point; the two types are never compared, and need not be. -/
   606  theorem proofIrrel_sound [LevelOracle] {Γ : List Expr} {a ta tta b tb ttb : Expr} {u v : Level}
   607      (hta : InferSem m φ Γ a ta) (htta : InferSem m φ Γ ta tta)
   608      (hu : RedSem m φ Γ tta (Expr.sort u)) (hu0 : LevelOracle.eq u .zero = true)
   609      (htb : InferSem m φ Γ b tb) (httb : InferSem m φ Γ tb ttb)
   610      (hv : RedSem m φ Γ ttb (Expr.sort v)) (hv0 : LevelOracle.eq v .zero = true) :
   611      DefEqSem m φ Γ a b := by
   612    intro ρ hs _ _
   613    rw [eq_pt_of_prop hta htta hu hu0 ρ hs, eq_pt_of_prop htb httb hv hv0 ρ hs]

   309  theorem DefEq.proofIrrel_sound {d : Nat}
   310      {a ta tta b tb ttb : Expr} {u v : Level}
   311      (hta : InferSemIO m φ d a ta) (htta : InferSemIO m φ d ta tta)
   312      (hu : RedSem m φ d tta (.sort u)) (hu0 : Level.isEquiv u .zero = some true)
   313      (htb : InferSemIO m φ d b tb) (httb : InferSemIO m φ d tb ttb)
   314      (hv : RedSem m φ d ttb (.sort v)) (hv0 : Level.isEquiv v .zero = some true) :

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L646-L680
   646  theorem pi_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A B s t : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen}
   647      (hA : InferSem m φ Γ A s) (hu : RedSem m φ Γ s (Expr.sort u))
   648      (hB : InferSem m φ (A :: Γ) B t) (hv : RedSem m φ (A :: Γ) t (Expr.sort v))
   649      (hz : Level.zeroness v = pw) :
   650      InferSem m φ Γ (Expr.pi A pw B) (Expr.sort (.imax u v)) := by
   651    intro ρ hs
   652    obtain ⟨hwA, hws, hmemA⟩ := hA ρ hs
   653    obtain ⟨-, hes⟩ := hu ρ hs hws
   654    rw [hes, interp_sort] at hmemA
   655    have hbody : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A →
   656        WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) B ∧ interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) B ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ v) := by
   657      intro x hx
   658      have hs' : Sat m.M φ (A :: Γ) (cons x ρ) := (Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, hwA, hx⟩
   659      obtain ⟨hwB, hwt, hmemB⟩ := hB (cons x ρ) hs'
   660      obtain ⟨-, het⟩ := hv (cons x ρ) hs' hwt
   661      rw [het, interp_sort] at hmemB
   662      exact ⟨hwB, hmemB⟩
   663    have hzero := holds_of_zeroness (φ := φ) hz
   664    refine ⟨?_, .sort, ?_⟩
   665    · rw [WellDenoted_pi]
   666      refine ⟨hwA, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).1, fun hp x hx => ?_⟩
   667      have := (hbody x hx).2
   668      rwa [hzero.mp hp] at this
   669    · rw [interp_pi, interp_sort, Level.eval_imax]
   670      by_cases h0 : Level.eval φ v = 0
   671      · rw [hzero.mpr h0, (Level.imaxNat_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr h0]
   672        exact piR_true_mem_univ_zero
   673      · have hp : pw.holds φ = false := by
   674          cases hh : pw.holds φ
   675          · rfl
   676          · exact absurd (hzero.mp hh) h0
   677        rw [hp, Level.imaxNat_of_ne_zero h0]
   678        refine piR_false_mem_univ (by omega) (univ_mono (Nat.le_max_left _ _) hmemA) ?_
   679        intro x hx
   680        exact univ_mono (Nat.le_max_right _ _) (hbody x hx).2

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L46-L48
    46  theorem holds_of_zeroness {v : Level} {pw : PropWhen} (h : Level.zeroness v = pw) :
    47      pw.holds φ = true ↔ Level.eval φ v = 0 := by
    48    subst h; exact Level.holds_zeroness φ v

   271      (hv : RedSem m φ (d + 1) bs (.sort v))
   272      (hz : Level.zeronessOf v = mb.pw) :
   273      InferSem m φ g d (.forallE ty body mb) (.sort (.imax u v)) := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L688-L722
   688  theorem lam_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A b s bt btt : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen}
   689      (hA : InferSem m φ Γ A s) (_hu : RedSem m φ Γ s (Expr.sort u))
   690      (hb : InferSem m φ (A :: Γ) b bt)
   691      (hbt : InferSem m φ (A :: Γ) bt btt) (hv : RedSem m φ (A :: Γ) btt (Expr.sort v))
   692      (hz : Level.zeroness v = pw) :
   693      InferSem m φ Γ (Expr.lam A pw b) (Expr.pi A pw bt) := by
   694    intro ρ hs
   695    obtain ⟨hwA, -, -⟩ := hA ρ hs
   696    have hbody : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A →
   697        WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) b ∧ WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt ∧
   698        interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt ∧
   699        interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ v) := by
   700      intro x hx
   701      have hs' : Sat m.M φ (A :: Γ) (cons x ρ) := (Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, hwA, hx⟩
   702      obtain ⟨hwb, hwbt, hmemb⟩ := hb (cons x ρ) hs'
   703      obtain ⟨-, hwbtt, hmembt⟩ := hbt (cons x ρ) hs'
   704      obtain ⟨-, hebtt⟩ := hv (cons x ρ) hs' hwbtt
   705      rw [hebtt, interp_sort] at hmembt
   706      exact ⟨hwb, hwbt, hmemb, hmembt⟩
   707    have hzero := holds_of_zeroness (φ := φ) hz
   708    have hpi : WellDenoted m.M φ ρ (Expr.pi A pw bt) := by
   709      rw [WellDenoted_pi]
   710      refine ⟨hwA, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.1, fun hp x hx => ?_⟩
   711      have := (hbody x hx).2.2.2
   712      rwa [hzero.mp hp] at this
   713    refine ⟨?_, hpi, ?_⟩
   714    · rw [WellDenoted_lam]
   715      refine ⟨hwA, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).1, fun x => interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt,
   716        fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.2.1, fun hp x hx => ?_⟩
   717      have := (hbody x hx).2.2.2
   718      rwa [hzero.mp hp] at this
   719    · rw [interp_lam, interp_pi]
   720      refine lamR_mem (fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.2.1) fun hp x hx => ?_
   721      have := (hbody x hx).2.2.2
   722      rwa [hzero.mp hp] at this
