== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L732-L748
   732  theorem app_sound {Γ : List Expr} {f a tf A B ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen}
   733      (hf : InferSem m φ Γ f tf) (hr : RedSem m φ Γ tf (Expr.pi A pw B))
   734      (ha : InferSem m φ Γ a ta) (hd : DefEqSem m φ Γ ta A) :
   735      InferSem m φ Γ (Expr.app f a) (B.inst a) := by
   736    intro ρ hs
   737    obtain ⟨hwf, hwtf, hmemf⟩ := hf ρ hs
   738    obtain ⟨hwpi, hepi⟩ := hr ρ hs hwtf
   739    rw [hepi] at hmemf
   740    obtain ⟨hwa, hwta, hmema⟩ := ha ρ hs
   741    have hwpi' := hwpi
   742    rw [WellDenoted_pi] at hwpi'
   743    rw [hd ρ hs hwta hwpi'.1] at hmema
   744    refine ⟨WellDenoted_app_of m.M φ hwf hwa hwpi hmemf hmema,
   745      (WellDenoted_inst0 m.M φ hwa).mpr (hwpi'.2.1 _ hmema), ?_⟩
   746    rw [interp_app, interp_inst0]
   747    rw [interp_pi] at hmemf
   748    exact app_mem_piR hmemf hmema

   138  theorem refl_sound {Γ : List Expr} {e : Expr} : RedSem m φ Γ e e :=

   141  theorem trans_sound {Γ : List Expr} {e₁ e₂ e₃ : Expr}
   142      (h₁ : RedSem m φ Γ e₁ e₂) (h₂ : RedSem m φ Γ e₂ e₃) : RedSem m φ Γ e₁ e₃ := by
   143    intro ρ hs hw

   148  theorem appFn_sound {Γ : List Expr} {f f' a : Expr} (h : RedSem m φ Γ f f') :
   149      RedSem m φ Γ (Expr.app f a) (Expr.app f' a) := by
   150    intro ρ hs hw
   151    rw [WellDenoted_app] at hw
   152    obtain ⟨hf, ha, p, A, B, hslot, hmem, hB⟩ := hw
   153    obtain ⟨hf', he⟩ := h ρ hs hf
   154    refine ⟨?_, by simp [he]⟩
   155    rw [WellDenoted_app]
   156    exact ⟨hf', ha, p, A, B, he ▸ hslot, hmem, hB⟩

   516      (hA : DefEqSem m φ Γ A₁ A₂) (hB : DefEqSem m φ (A₂ :: Γ) B₁ B₂) :

   151  theorem Infer.fvar_sound {g : Grade} {d idx : Nat} {ty : Expr} (h : idx < d) :
   152      InferSem m φ g d (.fvar idx ty) ty := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L222-L236
   222  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately** (`Rel.lean:310-333`, task
   223  #309).  The relation is the checker's verdict on two terms that are
   224  well-formed *together*, a fact no rule states because well-formedness
   225  is semantic (`WellDenoted`) and may not enter this inductive.  Every
   226  rule respects one discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq`
   227  premise is a subterm of the conclusion or is produced by a `Red` or
   228  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   229  always has the premise's terms — and their invariant — in hand.  A
   230  `trans` rule is the unique rule that would break it: its middle term
   231  comes from nowhere, so nothing supplies its invariant, and the
   232  induction has nothing to apply the hypothesis to.  In the real checker
   233  the rule is not merely unprovable but unsound (`fvar`s carry
   234  annotations `DefEq.fvar` does not compare while `DefEq.proofFast`
   235  reads; `trans` lets the two meet).  The one sound chaining is "reduce,
   236  then continue": `redL`. -/

>>> whitepaper/sections/03-definitions.typ

== whitepaper/Fragment/Env.lean#L55-L92
    55  /-- What kind of constant a name is stored as. -/
    56  inductive ConstKind where
    57    /-- A definition: its value unfolds (δ). -/
    58    | defn (value : Expr)
    59    /-- An inductive type former with `numParams` parameters,
    60    `numIndices` indices and these constructors — and the block's
    61    specification it was generated from (`Spec.lean`), which a later
    62    block nesting through this one reads back (con-leche stores the
    63    block's shape with the former likewise, `IndCaps`). -/
    64    | induct (numParams numIndices : Nat) (ctors : List Name) (spec : IndSpec)
    65    /-- A constructor of the inductive `induct`, with `numParams`
    66    parameters (the inductive's) and `nfields` fields. -/
    67    | ctor (induct : Name) (numParams nfields : Nat)
    68    /-- A recursor with the given telescope shape — `numParams`
    69    parameters, `numMotives` motives, `numMinors` minor premises,
    70    `numIndices` indices, then the major premise — and its rules. -/
    71    | recursor (numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat) (rules : List RecRule)
    72    deriving DecidableEq
    73  
    74  namespace ConstKind
    75  
    76  /-- The value a definition unfolds to. -/
    77  def value? : ConstKind → Option Expr
    78    | defn v => some v
    79    | _ => none
    80  
    81  end ConstKind
    82  
    83  /-- A stored constant: its level parameters, its type (closed, over
    84  those parameters) and its kind. -/
    85  structure ConstInfo where
    86    /-- The level parameters. -/
    87    lparams : List Name
    88    /-- The declared type, a closed term over `lparams`. -/

    90    /-- The kind. -/
    91    kind : ConstKind

== whitepaper/Fragment/Syntax.lean#L104-L112
   104  /-- Instantiate the level parameters `ps` at the levels `ls`, in
   105  sorts, constants and annotations. -/
   106  def instL (ps : List Name) (ls : List Level) : Expr → Expr
   107    | bvar i => bvar i
   108    | sort u => sort (u.subst ps ls)
   109    | const c us => const c (us.map (Level.subst ps ls))
   110    | app f a => app (instL ps ls f) (instL ps ls a)
   111    | lam A pw b => lam (instL ps ls A) (pw.substL ps ls) (instL ps ls b)
   112    | pi A pw B => pi (instL ps ls A) (pw.substL ps ls) (instL ps ls B)

== whitepaper/Fragment/PropWhen.lean#L322-L329
   322  /-- **Level substitution on a datum**: instantiating the declaration's
   323  parameters `ps` at levels `ls`, "all of `qs` zero" becomes "each
   324  substitute of a `q ∈ qs` zero" — the conjunction of the substitutes'
   325  zero-ness data.  Mirrors `Level.substPW` (`ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean`). -/
   326  def substL (ps : List Name) (ls : List Level) : PropWhen → PropWhen
   327    | never => never
   328    | whenZero qs =>
   329      qs.list.foldr (fun q acc => (Level.zeroness (Level.lookupLevel ps ls q)).inter acc) always

== ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean#L230-L241
   230  def Expr.instantiateLevelParams (ks : List Name) (us : List Level) : Expr → Expr
   231    | .bvar i => .bvar i
   232    | .fvar idx ty => .fvar idx (ty.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   233    | .sort u => .sort (Level.subst ks us u)
   234    | .const n vs => .const n (vs.map (Level.subst ks us))
   235    | .app f a => .app (f.instantiateLevelParams ks us) (a.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   236    | .lam ty body m =>
   237      .lam (ty.instantiateLevelParams ks us) (body.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   238        ⟨Level.substPW ks us m.pw⟩
   239    | .forallE ty body m =>
   240      .forallE (ty.instantiateLevelParams ks us) (body.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   241        ⟨Level.substPW ks us m.pw⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L585-L599
   585  /-- **A definition is accepted** (con-leche's `checkDefnVal`): the
   586  name is fresh, the declared type's type reduces to a sort, the
   587  value's inferred type is definitionally equal to the declared type,
   588  and both terms use only the declared level parameters.  That is the
   589  one scope condition the typing derivations do not give (the sort rule
   590  accepts `Sort u` at any level `u`); closedness and stored constants
   591  they do give (`Infer.closedAt`, `Infer.consts`,
   592  `ScopeOfInfer.lean`), so the environment section recovers the full
   593  scope of both terms (`DefOk.type_scoped`, `DefOk.value_scoped`). -/
   594  def DefOk (env : Env) (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) : Prop :=
   595    env.find? c = none ∧
   596    (∃ s u, Infer env [] ci.type s ∧ Red env [] s (.sort u)) ∧
   597    (∃ v T, ci.kind = .defn v ∧ Infer env [] v T ∧ DefEq env [] T ci.type ∧
   598      v.lparamsIn ci.lparams = true) ∧
   599    ci.type.lparamsIn ci.lparams = true

== ConLeche/Kernel/CheckerBase.lean#L96-L116
    96  def checkConstantVal (ops : CheckerOps m) (env : Env) (cv : ConstantVal) : m ConstantVal := do
    97    if (env.find? cv.name).isSome then
    98      throw (.invalid s!"duplicate declaration {cv.name}")
    99    if reservedBasisNames.contains cv.name then
   100      throw (.invalid s!"reserved basis name {cv.name}")
   101    if cv.name.isProjFnShape then
   102      throw (.invalid s!"reserved projection name {cv.name}")
   103    unless Name.nodup cv.levelParams do
   104      throw (.invalid s!"duplicate universe parameters in {cv.name}")
   105    unless cv.type.looseBVarsBounded 0 do
   106      throw (.invalid s!"loose bound variable in type of {cv.name}")
   107    if cv.type.hasFvar then
   108      throw (.invalid s!"unexpected free variable in type of {cv.name}")
   109    let type ← ops.annotate env 0 cv.type
   110    unless type.allLevelParamsDefined cv.levelParams do
   111      throw (.invalid s!"undeclared universe parameter in type of {cv.name}")
   112    unless type.constsResolve env do
   113      throw (unresolvedConstsError s!"type of {cv.name}" type)
   114    let stype ← ops.inferType env 0 type
   115    let _u ← ops.ensureSort env 0 stype
   116    pure { cv with type := type }

== ConLeche/Kernel/Checker.lean#L34-L50
    34  def checkDefnVal (ops : CheckerOps m) (env : Env) (cv : ConstantVal)
    35      (value : Expr) (hint : ReducibilityHint) : m Env := do
    36    unless value.looseBVarsBounded 0 do
    37      throw (.invalid s!"loose bound variable in value of {cv.name}")
    38    if value.hasFvar then
    39      throw (.invalid s!"unexpected free variable in value of {cv.name}")
    40    let value ← ops.annotate env 0 value
    41    unless value.allLevelParamsDefined cv.levelParams do
    42      throw (.invalid s!"undeclared universe parameter in value of {cv.name}")
    43    unless value.constsResolve env do
    44      throw (unresolvedConstsError s!"value of {cv.name}" value)
    45    let vtype ← ops.inferType env 0 value
    46    unless ← ops.isDefEq env 0 vtype cv.type do
    47      throw (.invalid s!"type mismatch in definition {cv.name}")
    48    pure ⟨.defnInfo cv value hint :: env.consts⟩
    49  
    50  /-- Check a `theorem` declaration's value against its checked constant

== whitepaper/Fragment/Interp.lean#L124-L130
   124  def interp (M : Name → List Nat → V) (φ : Name → Nat) : (Nat → V) → Expr → V
   125    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   126    | _, .sort u => univ (u.eval φ)
   127    | _, .const c ls => M c (ls.map (Level.eval φ))
   128    | ρ, .app f a => app (interp M φ ρ f) (interp M φ ρ a)
   129    | ρ, .lam A pw b => lamR (pw.holds φ) (interp M φ ρ A) fun x => interp M φ (cons x ρ) b
   130    | ρ, .pi A pw B => piR (pw.holds φ) (interp M φ ρ A) fun x => interp M φ (cons x ρ) B

== whitepaper/Fragment/EnvModel.lean#L192-L229
   192  /-- **A model of an environment**: the assignment and the laws. -/
   193  structure EnvModel (V : Type u) [SetLib V] (env : Env) where
   194    /-- The set of every constant at every list of concrete levels. -/
   195    M : Name → List Nat → V
   196    /-- Every stored constant's type, instantiated, is well-denoted, and
   197    the constant is a member of it — at every valuation and every
   198    environment (the types are closed, so `ρ` is irrelevant, and stating
   199    it for all `ρ` saves a closedness lemma). -/
   200    type_ok : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo), env.find? c = some ci →
   201      ∀ (φ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V) (ls : List Level), ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
   202        WellDenoted M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls) ∧
   203        M c (ls.map (Level.eval φ)) ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls)
   204    /-- A definition's value, instantiated, is well-denoted and denotes
   205    the constant. -/
   206    unfold : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (v : Expr), env.find? c = some ci →
   207      ci.value? = some v →
   208      ∀ (φ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V) (ls : List Level), ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
   209        WellDenoted M φ ρ (v.instL ci.lparams ls) ∧
   210        interp M φ ρ (v.instL ci.lparams ls) = M c (ls.map (Level.eval φ))
   211    /-- Every plain rule of every stored recursor satisfies its ι law. -/
   212    rec_rules : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat)
   213      (rules : List RecRule),
   214      env.find? c = some ci →
   215      ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   216      ∀ rl ∈ rules, rl.inst = none → ∀ cij : ConstInfo, env.find? rl.ctor = some cij →
   217        RecRuleLaw M c ci numParams (numParams + numMotives + numMinors)
   218          (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) rl cij
   219    /-- Every nested rule of every stored recursor satisfies its ι law,
   220    at its constructor's own parameter count. -/
   221    rec_rules_nested : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat)
   222      (rules : List RecRule),
   223      env.find? c = some ci →
   224      ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   225      ∀ rl ∈ rules, ∀ (lvs : List Level) (pinst : List Expr), rl.inst = some (lvs, pinst) →
   226        ∀ (cij : ConstInfo) (I : Name) (nPc nf : Nat), env.find? rl.ctor = some cij →
   227          cij.kind = .ctor I nPc nf →
   228          RecRuleLawN M c ci nPc (numParams + numMotives + numMinors)
   229            (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) rl cij

   159  structure EnvModelM (μ : CheckMode) (env : Env) where
   160    /-- the environment carrier, contained -/
   161    base2 : EnvModel V env
   162    /-- every leaf is bit-valid (`acval_wellDenoted`'s `AnnotValid` half) -/

   171      denoteMeta base2.acval env ψ 0 c.toConstantVal.type = some ta →

   174    table's constant type is the closed dummy `Sort 1` and its leaf is

== whitepaper/Fragment/EnvModel.lean#L231-L237
   231  /-- The empty environment has a model: any assignment, vacuous laws. -/

   235    unfold := fun _ _ _ h => by simp at h
   236    rec_rules := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h => by simp at h

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L817-L821
   817  theorem soundness [LevelOracle] (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) :
   818      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e e' : Expr}, Red env Γ e e' → RedSem m φ Γ e e') ∧
   819      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {a b : Expr}, DefEq env Γ a b → DefEqSem m φ Γ a b) ∧
   820      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e T : Expr}, Infer env Γ e T → InferSem m φ Γ e T) :=
   821    ⟨red_sound, defeq_sound, infer_sound⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L193-L199
   193  theorem delta_sound {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {ls : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo} {v : Expr}
   194      (hfind : env.find? c = some ci) (hv : ci.value? = some v)
   195      (hls : ls.length = ci.lparams.length) :
   196      RedSem m φ Γ (Expr.const c ls) (v.instL ci.lparams ls) := by
   197    intro ρ _ _
   198    obtain ⟨hw, he⟩ := m.unfold c ci v hfind hv φ ρ ls hls

== whitepaper/Fragment/Spec.lean#L80-L103
    80  /-- **The data of a single inductive block** without its class
    81  (con-leche's `MemberShape`/`InductiveShape`, `BlockParts.lean:62`,

    83  structure IndBase where
    84    /-- The type former's name. -/
    85    name : Name
    86    /-- The block's level parameters. -/
    87    lparams : List Name

    97    recName : Name
    98    /-- Large elimination: the recursor eliminates into `Sort ℓ` for a
    99    fresh level parameter `ℓ`; otherwise into `Prop`. -/
   100    large : Bool
   101    /-- The fresh elimination level parameter (read only if `large`). -/
   102    elim : Name
   103    deriving DecidableEq

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/BlockParts.lean#L104-L122
   104  structure BlockShape where
   105    /-- the members in block order -/
   106    members : List MemberShape
   107    /-- the block's recursors, in the order the stream exports them (any

== whitepaper/Fragment/Spec.lean#L28-L42
    28  /-- A constructor field, as the positivity check classifies it
    29  (con-leche's `RecFieldKind`, `FieldTele.lean:29`).  Its domain is an
    30  expression under the parameters and the earlier fields. -/
    31  inductive Field where
    32    /-- An ordinary field: any domain that does not mention the block. -/
    33    | ordinary (A : Expr)
    34    /-- A reflexive field: `∀ tele, I params es` — a function space into
    35    the family at the block's parameters and the index expressions `es`;
    36    `tele` is a context (innermost first) under the parameters and the
    37    earlier fields, `es` a spine (outermost first) under `tele` too.
    38    With an empty telescope the field is simply **recursive**: the
    39    family itself (`reflexive [] es`) — one kind covers both, as the
    40    generated terms and the model treat them alike.  (Con-leche keeps
    41    them apart: `RecFieldKind.recursive`/`.reflexive`, `FieldTele.lean`.) -/
    42    | reflexive (tele : List Expr) (es : List Expr)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/Positivity.lean#L598-L608
   598  /-- The field's kind as the run found it: hole-free, a member hole
   599  (finitary or under `Π` binders), an instantiation IN PROGRESS (a `Y`
   600  hole — only inside a container's constructors), or an accepted
   601  instantiation (under `Π` binders when `refl`). -/
   602  inductive NestFieldKind where
   603    | ordinary
   604    | recursive (tgt : Nat)
   605    | reflexive (tgt : Nat)
   606    | inProgress
   607    | nested (refl : Bool)
   608    deriving DecidableEq, Inhabited

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L622-L636
   622  /-- The scope of a field's pieces: with `k` earlier fields, an
   623  ordinary domain is in scope under the parameters and them; a
   624  reflexive field's telescope entries under the earlier telescope
   625  entries as well, and its index expressions under the whole telescope
   626  (under the parameters and the earlier fields alone when the telescope
   627  is empty); a reflexive field's index expressions are as many as the
   628  indices.  No piece
   629  mentions the block (it is not stored in `env`): that is **strict
   630  positivity** in the shape the fragment admits (con-leche's
   631  `nestPos`, `ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/Positivity.lean:1453`). -/
   632  def fieldScoped (env : Env) (k : Nat) : Field → Prop
   633    | .ordinary A => Expr.Scoped env S.lparams (S.nP + k) A
   634    | .reflexive tele es =>
   635      (∀ t T, tele[t]? = some T → Expr.Scoped env S.lparams (S.nP + k + (tele.length - 1 - t)) T) ∧
   636      es.length = S.nI ∧ (∀ e ∈ es, Expr.Scoped env S.lparams (S.nP + k + tele.length) e)

   639  /-- **No field reads an earlier recursive field**: an ordinary domain
   640  and a reflexive field's telescope entries and index expressions do not
   641  use the variable of any earlier reflexive field (con-leche's `structUsedLater`
   642  guard, `StructParts.lean:393`, run by `nestCtors`, `Positivity.lean:1247`:
   643  the model reads the domains at a frame with arbitrary recursive slots). -/
   644  def fieldNoRecDep (earlier : List Field) : Field → Prop

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L394-L407
   394  def classRecTyOk (ops : CheckerOps m) (fe : FEnv) (g : ClassGen) (k : Nat) (rc : RecShape)
   395      (cvRi : ConstantVal) (c : Nat) : m ConstantVal := do
   396    let ci := g.cls.getD c default
   397    unless rc.tgt == ci.member.getD k do
   398      throw (.invalid "generated recursor: the recursor record's member is not its class's")
   399    unless rc.rP == g.nP + g.slots.length && rc.mI == rc.rP + ci.nIdx do
   400      throw (.invalid "generated recursor: the recursor record's rule prefix or major index is \
   401        not the generated one")
   402    let gty ← unwrapOr (classGenRecTy g c) (.internal "generated recursor: recursor type")
   403    let cvG ← classConstOk ops fe { rc.cvR with type := gty }
   404    unless ← ops.isDefEq fe.env 0 cvRi.type cvG.type do
   405      throw (.invalid s!"generated recursor: the type of {rc.cvR.name} is not the generated one \
   406        (official: invalid recursor)")
   407    pure cvG

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/ClassRead.lean#L24-L32
    24  This file READS that data off the recursor types, syntactically, and
    25  checks nothing.  Everything it returns is re-established by the stage:
    26  every class is checked like a major (`targetMajorOf`), the inductive
    27  hypotheses read here must be exactly the positivity check's recursive
    28  fields, and every recursor TYPE is generated from the classes and the
    29  positivity check's recorded constructors and compared by `isDefEq` with
    30  the stream's.  What the stage installs is the generated family, never
    31  anything read here: a wrong reading can only make the generated type
    32  differ from the stream's, i.e. reject.

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L223-L225
   223  /-- The motive's type, under the parameters:
   224  `∀ indices (t : I params indices), Sort ℓ`. -/
   225  def motiveTy : Expr := mkPis .never (S.famVars 0 :: S.indices) (.sort S.ℓ)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L236-L247
   236  /-- **An inductive hypothesis' type** for the field with `k` earlier
   237  fields, `l` earlier hypotheses, `o` binders between the parameters
   238  and the fields (the motive sits `nF + l + o - 1` binders above):
   239  `∀ tele, motive es (f tele)` at a reflexive field (`motive es f` when
   240  the telescope is empty). -/
   241  def ihTy (nF k l o : Nat) : Field → Expr
   242    | .ordinary _ => .sort .zero
   243    | .reflexive tele es =>
   244      let m := tele.length
   245      mkPis S.q (liftCtx (fun t T => atCtx nF k l o t T) tele)
   246        (mkAppN (.bvar (nF + l + o - 1 + m))
   247          (es.map (atCtx nF k l o m) ++ [mkAppN (.bvar (nF - 1 - k + l + m)) (varsAt 0 m)]))

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L261-L270
   261  /-- **A minor premise** for constructor `j`, under the parameters, the

   266    let nIh := c.recFields.length
   267    mkPis S.q (S.ihCtx c j ++ S.fieldCtxAt c (j + 1))

   269        (c.idx.map (atCtx nF nF nIh (j + 1) 0) ++

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L181-L188
   181  def classGenRecTy (g : ClassGen) (c : Nat) : Option Expr := do
   182    let pre := g.pre
   183    let rP := pre.length
   184    let (ifs, maj) ← g.major c rP
   185    let t : Expr := .fvar (rP + ifs.length) maj
   186    pure (closeTelescope (pre ++ ifs.map g.binder ++ [(maj, g.bm)]) 0
   187      (Expr.mkAppN (g.motVar c) (ifs ++ [t])))

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L193-L212
   193  def classGenRule (g : ClassGen) (recOf : Nat → Option Name) (rlvls : List Level) (c : Nat)
   194      (x : ClassCtor) : Option Expr := do
   195    let pre := g.pre
   196    let rP := pre.length
   197    let (s, _) ← (List.range g.slots.length).zip g.slots |>.find? fun (_, sl) =>
   198      match sl with | .minor c' C _ => c' == c && C == x.cv.name | _ => false
   199    let (fvs, _) ← openPisAtFvars x.nF x.tyD rP
   200    let ws ← targetPiDomsWith fvs x.tyN
   201    let pvars := (List.range rP).map fun i => if i < g.nP then g.params.getD i default else
   202      g.slotVar (i - g.nP)
   203    let ihs ← (List.range x.nF).filterMapM fun i =>
   204      match x.kinds.getD i .ordinary with
   205      | .ordinary => some none
   206      | .recursive t tele => do
   207        let f := fvs.getD i default
   208        let (xs, idx) ← g.ihParts t tele (ws.getD i default) (rP + x.nF)
   209        let r ← recOf t
   210        pure (some (closeLams (xs.map g.binder) (rP + x.nF)
   211          (Expr.mkAppN (.const r rlvls) (pvars ++ idx ++ [Expr.mkAppN f xs]))))
   212    pure (closeLams (pre ++ fvs.map g.binder) 0 (Expr.mkAppN (g.slotVar s) (fvs ++ ihs)))

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L704-L711
   704  /-- **The subsingleton criterion** for a field of sort `v` at
   705  position `i` (innermost first) of a constructor with index
   706  expressions `idx`: the field is a proposition, or it is one of the
   707  result's indices (official's `elim_only_at_universe_zero` at one
   708  constructor; con-leche's `checkStructFieldSortsI`).  Required only of a
   709  large eliminator on a block whose sort may be `Prop`. -/
   710  def SubsingletonField (v : Level) (i : Nat) (idx : List Expr) : Prop :=
   711    S.large = true → ¬ S.NeverProp → (LevelOracle.eq v .zero = true ∨ Expr.bvar i ∈ idx)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L757
   757    (S.large = true → ¬ S.NeverProp → S.ctors.length ≤ 1) ∧

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L700-L702
   700  /-- "The result sort is never `Prop`": `1 ≤ u` at every valuation
   701  (con-leche's `Level.isNeverZero`). -/
   702  def NeverProp : Prop := LevelOracle.le (.succ .zero) S.sort = true

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/BlockRec.lean#L82-L84
    82  def blockLargeElimAllowed (p : BlockShape) (nested : Bool) : Bool :=
    83    p.resSort.isNeverZero ||
    84      (p.large && p.k == 1 && !nested && (p.numCtors == 0 || p.numCtors == 1))

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L571-L573
   571    if p.large && !blockLargeElimAllowed p (nestedBit || Ms.any (·.member.isNone)) then
   572      throw (.invalid "generated recursor: large eliminator on a block whose sort may be Prop \

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/SumInstall.lean#L85-L99
    85  def checkStructFieldSortsI (ops : CheckerOps m) (env : Env) (isProp large : Bool)
    86      (s : Level) (nP : Nat) (fvs idxArgs : List Expr) : Nat → m (List Level)
    87    | 0 => pure []
    88    | j + 1 => do
    89      let fv ← unwrapOr fvs[j]? (.internal "direct sum: field index")
    90      let ty ← ops.inferType env (nP + j) fv.fvarTypeD
    91      let u ← ops.ensureSort env (nP + j) ty
    92      if !isProp then
    93        unless ← liftFueled "level comparison" (Level.leq u s) do
    94          throw (.invalid "direct sum: field universe too large")
    95      else if large then
    96        unless Level.isEquiv u .zero == some true || idxArgs.contains fv do
    97          throw (.invalid "direct sum: large eliminator with a non-propositional \
    98            field outside the indices")
    99      let rest ← checkStructFieldSortsI ops env isProp large s nP fvs idxArgs j

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L693-L698
   693  /-- The universe bound on a field of sort `v`: the family is a
   694  proposition, or `v ≤ u` (official's "universe level of `type_of(arg)`
   695  is too big" check, `checkStructFieldSortsI`,
   696  `ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/SumInstall.lean:124`). -/
   697  def FieldBound (v : Level) : Prop :=
   698    LevelOracle.eq S.sort .zero = true ∨ LevelOracle.le v S.sort = true

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L713-L758
   713  /-- **The block is accepted** (con-leche's `checkBlock`,
   714  `ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/BlockTail.lean:143`):
   715  
   716  * the block's names are distinct and fresh;
   717  * the specification is in scope (closed, stored constants, declared
   718    level parameters — positivity included);
   719  * the generated type former's type has a sort in the current
   720    environment;
   721  * each generated constructor's type has a sort in the environment
   722    holding the former, every field's domain has a sort respecting the
   723    universe bound and, where a large eliminator asks it, the
   724    subsingleton criterion, and so does every binder of a reflexive
   725    field's telescope (the domain's sort implies it; the fragment lists
   726    it, as the checker infers it);
   727  * each rule's type (`ruleType`, the recursor's binder prefix with the
   728    constructor's fields in place of the indices and the major) has a
   729    sort in the environment holding the former and the constructors;
   730  * a large eliminator on a block whose sort may be `Prop` has at most
   731    one constructor (official's `elim_only_at_universe_zero`);
   732  * the generated recursor's type has a sort in the environment holding
   733    the former and the constructors.
   734  
   735  The recursor's rules are generated and stored, not checked: they
   736  mention the recursor.  Con-leche does type its generated rules, in
   737  the environment holding the recursors without their rules
   738  (`classRuleOk`, `GenRec.lean:427`); the fragment stores them as is. -/
   739  def Ok (env : Env) : Prop :=
   740    (S.name :: S.recName :: S.ctors.map (·.name)).Nodup ∧
   741    (∀ m ∈ S.name :: S.recName :: S.ctors.map (·.name), env.find? m = none) ∧
   742    S.Scoped env ∧
   743    (∃ T, Infer env [] S.indType T) ∧
   744    (∀ c ∈ S.ctors,
   745      (∃ T, Infer (S.envInd env) [] (S.ctorType c) T) ∧
   746      (∀ i A, (S.fieldCtx c.fields)[i]? = some A →
   747        ∃ s v, Infer (S.envInd env) ((S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params) A s ∧
   748          Red (S.envInd env) ((S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params) s (.sort v) ∧
   749          S.FieldBound v ∧ S.SubsingletonField v i c.idx) ∧
   750      (∀ i tele es, c.fields[i]? = some (.reflexive tele es) → ∀ t T, tele[t]? = some T →
   751        ∃ s w, Infer (S.envInd env)
   752            (tele.drop (t + 1) ++ (S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params) T s ∧
   753          Red (S.envInd env) (tele.drop (t + 1) ++ (S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params)
   754            s (.sort w) ∧
   755          S.FieldBound w) ∧
   756      (∃ T, Infer (S.envCtors env) [] (S.ruleType c) T)) ∧
   757    (S.large = true → ¬ S.NeverProp → S.ctors.length ≤ 1) ∧
   758    (∃ T, Infer (S.envCtors env) [] S.recType T)

   144      m Env := do

   312  /-- **A rule's type**: `∀ params motive minors fields, motive idx (C params fields)`
   313  — the recursor's binder prefix with the constructor's fields in place

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L427-L448
   427  def classRuleOk (ops : CheckerOps m) (w : StructWalkers) (feT feR : FEnv) (cvR : ConstantVal)
   428      (pw : PropWhen) (n : Nat) (gen : Expr) : m Expr := do
   429    unless gen.looseBVarsBounded 0 && !gen.hasFvar do
   430      throw (.internal s!"generated recursor: a rule of {cvR.name} is not closed")
   431    let genA := gen
   432    unless genA.allLevelParamsDefined cvR.levelParams do
   433      throw (.internal s!"generated recursor: a rule of {cvR.name} names an undeclared universe \
   434        parameter")
   435    unless w.resolve feR genA do
   436      throw (unresolvedConstsError s!"generated rule of {cvR.name}" genA)
   437    let _ ← ops.inferType feR.env 0 genA
   438    let (rbs, _) ← unwrapOr (genA.stripLams n)
   439      (.internal s!"generated recursor: a rule of {cvR.name} is not a λ-telescope over the \
   440        recursor's prefix and the constructor's fields")
   441    unless rbs.all (fun b => w.resolve feT b.1) do
   442      throw (unresolvedConstsError s!"the domains of a generated rule of {cvR.name}" genA)
   443    unless rbs.all (fun b => b.2.pw == pw) do
   444      throw (.internal s!"generated recursor: a rule of {cvR.name} does not annotate its \
   445        λ-binders with the family's elimination datum")
   446    pure genA
   447  
   448  /-- A recursor's generated rules, one per constructor of its class. -/

   528  def indInfo : ConstInfo := ⟨S.lparams, S.indType, .induct S.nP S.nI (S.ctors.map (·.name)) S⟩
   529  
   530  /-- A constructor's constant. -/
   531  def ctorInfo (c : CtorSpec) : ConstInfo :=
   532    ⟨S.lparams, S.ctorType c, .ctor S.name S.nP c.fields.length⟩
   533  
   534  /-- The recursor's constant: `nP` parameters, one motive, `n` minors,
   535  `nI` indices, the generated rules. -/
   536  def recInfo : ConstInfo := ⟨S.recLparams, S.recType, .recursor S.nP 1 S.n S.nI S.rules⟩
   537  
   538  /-- The environment with the type former added. -/
   539  def envInd (env : Env) : Env := env.add S.name S.indInfo
   540  
   541  /-- The environment with the type former and the constructors added,
   542  in order. -/
   543  def envCtors (env : Env) : Env :=
   544    S.ctors.foldl (fun e c => e.add c.name (S.ctorInfo c)) (S.envInd env)
   545  
   546  /-- `T.rec`'s constant in a nested block: `nP` parameters, two
   547  motives, `n + nK` minors, `nI` indices. -/
   548  def recInfoN (N : NestInfo) : ConstInfo :=
   549    ⟨S.recLparams, S.recTypeN N, .recursor S.nP 2 (S.n + N.nK) S.nI (S.rulesN N)⟩
   550  
   551  /-- `T.rec_1`'s constant: the same prefix, no indices. -/
   552  def rec1Info (N : NestInfo) : ConstInfo :=
   553    ⟨S.recLparams, S.rec1Type N, .recursor S.nP 2 (S.n + N.nK) 0 (S.rules1 N)⟩
   554  
   555  /-- **The installed nested block**: former, constructors, the two
   556  recursors. -/
   557  def installN (N : NestInfo) (env : Env) : Env :=
   558    ((S.envCtors env).add S.recName (S.recInfoN N)).add N.aux (S.rec1Info N)

   561  auxiliary recursor for a nested block. -/
   562  def install (env : Env) : Env :=
   563    match S.nest with
   564    | none => (S.envCtors env).add S.recName S.recInfo
   565    | some N => S.installN N env

   211    /-- Every plain rule of every stored recursor satisfies its ι law. -/

== whitepaper/Fragment/Univ.lean#L43-L88
    43  /-- **The positive universes are Grothendieck universes.**  `SetLib`
    44  with pairing, union, power set and replacement (the image of a set
    45  under any function of the ambient logic), the numerals and `ω`, and
    46  the laws: every `univ n` with `n ≠ 0` is transitive and closed under
    47  the four operations, and contains `ω`. -/
    48  class UnivLib (V : Type u) extends SetLib V where
    49    /-- The unordered pair. -/
    50    upair : V → V → V
    51    /-- The members of a pair. -/
    52    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
    53    /-- The union of the members. -/
    54    sUnion : V → V
    55    /-- The members of a union. -/
    56    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
    57    /-- The power set. -/
    58    power : V → V
    59    /-- The members of a power set: the subsets. -/
    60    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
    61    /-- Replacement: the image of a set under a function. -/
    62    image : (V → V) → V → V
    63    /-- The members of an image. -/
    64    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {A z : V}, Mem z (image f A) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w A ∧ z = f w
    65    /-- The numerals. -/
    66    nat : Nat → V
    67    /-- Distinct numbers have distinct numerals. -/
    68    nat_inj : ∀ {k l : Nat}, nat k = nat l → k = l
    69    /-- `ω`: the set of numerals. -/
    70    omega : V
    71    /-- The members of `ω`. -/
    72    mem_omega : ∀ {z : V}, Mem z omega ↔ ∃ k, z = nat k
    73    /-- A positive universe is transitive: a member of a member is a
    74    member. -/
    75    univ_trans : ∀ {n : Nat} {A x : V}, n ≠ 0 → Mem A (univ n) → Mem x A → Mem x (univ n)
    76    /-- A positive universe is closed under pairing. -/
    77    upair_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {a b : V}, n ≠ 0 →
    78      Mem a (univ n) → Mem b (univ n) → Mem (upair a b) (univ n)
    79    /-- A positive universe is closed under union. -/
    80    sUnion_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {x : V}, n ≠ 0 → Mem x (univ n) → Mem (sUnion x) (univ n)
    81    /-- A positive universe is closed under power set. -/
    82    power_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {x : V}, n ≠ 0 → Mem x (univ n) → Mem (power x) (univ n)
    83    /-- A positive universe is closed under replacement: the image of a
    84    member under a function into the universe is a member. -/
    85    image_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {f : V → V} {A : V}, n ≠ 0 → Mem A (univ n) →
    86      (∀ a, Mem a A → Mem (f a) (univ n)) → Mem (image f A) (univ n)
    87    /-- A positive universe contains `ω`. -/
    88    omega_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat}, n ≠ 0 → Mem omega (univ n)

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndLib.lean#L46-L63
    46  /-- **The library for inductive types**: the universes with tuples and
    47  tags. -/
    48  class IndLib (V : Type u) extends UnivLib V where
    49    /-- The n-ary tuple of a list of sets. -/
    50    tuple : List V → V
    51    /-- Tuples are injective. -/
    52    tuple_inj : ∀ {xs ys : List V}, tuple xs = tuple ys → xs = ys
    53    /-- A tuple of members of a positive universe is a member of it. -/
    54    tuple_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {xs : List V}, n ≠ 0 →
    55      (∀ x ∈ xs, Mem x (univ n)) → Mem (tuple xs) (univ n)
    56    /-- A value tagged with a number. -/
    57    tag : Nat → V → V
    58    /-- Tags are injective. -/
    59    tag_inj : ∀ {i j : Nat} {x y : V}, tag i x = tag j y → i = j ∧ x = y
    60    /-- A tagged member of a positive universe is a member of it. -/
    61    tag_mem_univ : ∀ {n i : Nat} {x : V}, n ≠ 0 → Mem x (univ n) → Mem (tag i x) (univ n)
    62    /-- A tagged value is never the point. -/
    63    tag_ne_pt : ∀ {i : Nat} {x : V}, tag i x ≠ pt

   127  /-- A separated part of a member of a universe is a member.

== whitepaper/Fragment/Univ.lean#L182-L199
   182  /-- **The union of an indexed family** `⋃ a ∈ A, F a`: replacement,
   183  then union.  Con-leche: `IsTGUniverse.famUnion_mem`,
   184  `ConLeche/SetTheory/Derive/Universe.lean`. -/
   185  def famUnion (A : V) (F : V → V) : V := sUnion (image F A)
   186  
   187  theorem mem_famUnion {A z : V} {F : V → V} : z ∈ˢ famUnion A F ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ˢ A ∧ z ∈ˢ F a := by
   188    unfold famUnion
   189    rw [mem_sUnion]
   190    constructor
   191    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hz⟩
   192      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
   193      exact ⟨a, ha, hz⟩
   194    · rintro ⟨a, ha, hz⟩
   195      exact ⟨F a, mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hz⟩
   196  
   197  theorem famUnion_mem_univ {n : Nat} {A : V} {F : V → V} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hA : A ∈ˢ univ n)
   198      (hF : ∀ a, a ∈ˢ A → F a ∈ˢ univ n) : famUnion A F ∈ˢ (univ n : V) :=
   199    sUnion_mem_univ hn (image_mem_univ hn hA hF)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Univ.lean#L217-L236
   217  /-- **The countable union** `F 0 ∪ F 1 ∪ …`: the union over `ω`, each
   218  numeral read back as its number.  Con-leche: `Tower.natUnion`,

   220  noncomputable def natUnion (F : Nat → V) : V := famUnion omega fun z => F (idx z)
   221  
   222  theorem mem_natUnion {F : Nat → V} {z : V} : z ∈ˢ natUnion F ↔ ∃ k, z ∈ˢ F k := by
   223    unfold natUnion
   224    rw [mem_famUnion]
   225    constructor
   226    · rintro ⟨w, -, hz⟩
   227      exact ⟨idx w, hz⟩
   228    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
   229      exact ⟨nat k, mem_omega.mpr ⟨k, rfl⟩, by rw [idx_nat]; exact hk⟩

   232  the one use of `ω`.  Con-leche: `Tower.natUnion_mem_univ_pos`,

   235      natUnion F ∈ˢ (univ n : V) :=
   236    famUnion_mem_univ hn (omega_mem_univ hn) fun _ _ => h _

== whitepaper/Fragment/Univ.lean#L29-L35
    29  **Infinity is not a convenience.**  `V_ω`, the hereditarily finite
    30  sets, is transitive and closed under pairing, union, power set and
    31  replacement, and the least fixed point of `X ↦ {∅} ∪ {x ∪ {x} | x ∈ X}`
    32  — accessible with a one-element bound — is `ω ∉ V_ω`.  So the theorem
    33  `closed_of_acc` (`Access.lean`) needs `ω ∈ univ n`, and uses it
    34  exactly once: the set of finite paths over the bound is a countable
    35  union (`natUnion`).

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L89-L93
    89  def IsTGUniverse {V : Type u} (mem : V → V → Prop) (u : V) : Prop :=
    90    (∀ y z, mem y u → mem z y → mem z u) ∧
    91    (∀ y z, mem y u → (∀ w, mem w z → mem w y) → mem z u) ∧
    92    (∀ y, mem y u → ∃ p, mem p u ∧ ∀ z, (∀ w, mem w z → mem w y) → mem z p) ∧
    93    (∀ y, (∀ w, mem w y → mem w u) → Equinumerous mem y u ∨ mem y u)

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L100
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L274-L294
   274  /-- **The set a field ranges over**, relative to a family `W` (index
   275  values to sets), at parameters `ps` and the earlier field values `fs`
   276  (innermost first): an ordinary field's domain; for a reflexive field
   277  the product over its telescope into the fibres of `W` at the field's
   278  index expressions read under the telescope's values — the fibre
   279  itself when the telescope is empty; for a container field the class
   280  at the fibre of `W` at the nested occurrence's index expressions
   281  (`classSet`: the container's family, read at the class's arguments
   282  with that fibre in the nested position; a plain block has no
   283  container field, and the clause is empty).  Con-leche: a field's
   284  reading with holes, `LfpDatum.fields`, read at the hole frame of the
   285  tuple (`HFits`, `BlockLfp.lean`); the container clause `contApp`
   286  through the container's lfp clause (`BlockLfpMono.lean`). -/
   287  def fieldSet (W : List V → V) (ps fs : List V) : Field → V
   288    | .ordinary A => interp M (S.ψ ls) (consList fs (envP ps)) A
   289    | .reflexive tele es =>
   290      piCtx M (S.ψ ls) (S.z ls) (consList fs (envP ps)) tele fun ρ' => W (S.idxVals M ls ρ' es)
   291    | .container =>
   292      match S.nest with
   293      | some N => S.classSet M ls N ps (W (S.memberIdx M ls N ps))
   294      | none => empty

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L306-L311
   306  /-- **Field values fitting a constructor's fields** (both innermost
   307  first) relative to a family: each value a member of its field's set
   308  at the earlier values.  Con-leche: `SpineFit` at the hole frame. -/
   309  def FitsFields (W : List V → V) (ps : List V) : List Field → List V → Prop
   310    | [], [] => True
   311    | f :: fs, v :: vs => FitsFields W ps fs vs ∧ v ∈ˢ S.fieldSet M ls W ps vs f

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L484-L533
   484  /-- **The fitting lists of a field list, as a set of tuples**:
   485  replacement and union along the fields (innermost first).
   486  Con-leche builds the fibre the same way, by replacement over the
   487  spines (`BlockLfp.lean`, `fibre`). -/
   488  noncomputable def fitsSet (W : List V → V) (ps : List V) : List Field → V
   489    | [] => sing (tuple [])
   490    | f :: fs => famUnion (fitsSet W ps fs) fun t =>
   491        famUnion (S.fieldSet M ls W ps (untuple t) f) fun v => sing (tuple (v :: untuple t))
   492  
   493  theorem mem_fitsSet {W : List V → V} {ps : List V} :
   494      ∀ {fields : List Field} {x : V},
   495        x ∈ˢ S.fitsSet M ls W ps fields ↔ ∃ fs, S.FitsFields M ls W ps fields fs ∧ x = tuple fs
   496    | [], x => by
   497      simp only [fitsSet, mem_sing]
   498      constructor
   499      · rintro rfl; exact ⟨[], trivial, rfl⟩
   500      · rintro ⟨fs, hfs, rfl⟩
   501        cases fs with
   502        | nil => rfl
   503        | cons _ _ => exact hfs.elim
   504    | f :: fields, x => by
   505      simp only [fitsSet, mem_famUnion, mem_sing]
   506      constructor
   507      · rintro ⟨t, ht, v, hv, rfl⟩
   508        obtain ⟨fs, hfs, rfl⟩ := mem_fitsSet.mp ht
   509        rw [untuple_tuple] at hv ⊢
   510        exact ⟨v :: fs, ⟨hfs, hv⟩, rfl⟩
   511      · rintro ⟨fs, hfs, rfl⟩
   512        cases fs with
   513        | nil => exact hfs.elim
   514        | cons v fs =>
   515          refine ⟨tuple fs, mem_fitsSet.mpr ⟨fs, hfs.1, rfl⟩, v, ?_, ?_⟩
   516          · rw [untuple_tuple]; exact hfs.2
   517          · rw [untuple_tuple]
   518  
   519  /-- **The fibre of constructor `j`** at the family `W` and the index
   520  values `is`: the constructor values of the fitting lists whose index
   521  expressions read as `is`. -/
   522  noncomputable def ctorFibre (W : List V → V) (ps is : List V) (j : Nat) (c : CtorSpec) : V :=
   523    open Classical in
   524    image (fun t => S.ctorVal ls j (untuple t))
   525      (sep (S.fitsSet M ls W ps c.fields) fun t =>
   526        is = S.idxVals M ls (consList (untuple t) (envP ps)) c.idx)
   527  
   528  /-- **The block's operator** on families: the fibre at `is` is the
   529  union over the constructors of their fibres.  Con-leche: the hole
   530  operator `holeOp` (`BlockDatum.lean`), the operator of
   531  `LfpClause.functor`. -/
   532  noncomputable def famOp (ps : List V) (W : List V → V) (is : List V) : V :=
   533    listUnion ((List.range S.n).map fun j => S.ctorFibre M ls W ps is j (S.ctors.getD j ⟨"", [], []⟩))

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndLib.lean#L81-L86
    81  /-- The function space is monotone in its fibres. -/
    82  theorem piSet_mono {A : V} {B B' : V → V} (h : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ⊆ˢ B' x) :
    83      piSet A B ⊆ˢ piSet A B' := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L596-L609
   596  /-- **A field's set grows with the family.** -/
   597  theorem fieldSet_mono {ps : List V} (hc : S.ContOk M ls ps) {W W' : List V → V}
   598      (hW : InUniv (S.u₀ ls) W) (hW' : InUniv (S.u₀ ls) W') (hle : FamLe W W') (fs : List V) :
   599      ∀ f : Field, S.fieldSet M ls W ps fs f ⊆ˢ S.fieldSet M ls W' ps fs f
   600    | .ordinary _ => Sub.refl _
   601    | .reflexive tele es => by
   602      simp only [fieldSet]
   603      exact piCtx_sub M _ (fun _ _ => hle _) fun hz _ _ => S.fibre_mem_univ_zero ls hW' hz _
   604    | .container => by
   605      cases hN : S.nest with
   606      | none => rw [S.fieldSet_container_none M ls hN]; exact empty_sub _
   607      | some N =>
   608        rw [S.fieldSet_container M ls hN, S.fieldSet_container M ls hN]
   609        exact (hc N hN).mono _ _ (hle _) (hW _) (hW' _)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Access.lean#L68-L78
    68  /-- **Accessibility with the bound `A`** of an operator from families
    69  over `ι` to families over `κ`: every element `x` the operator
    70  produces at `j` from a family `W` in the universe has a support — a
    71  subset `B` of `A` and occurrences `g a ∈ W` for `a ∈ B` — such that
    72  `x` is produced at `j` from every family `W'` in the universe
    73  containing the support.  Con-leche: `AccTuple`,
    74  `ConLeche/SetModel/Access.lean`. -/
    75  def AccFam (n : Nat) (Φ : (ι → V) → κ → V) (A : V) : Prop :=
    76    ∀ W, InUniv n W → ∀ j x, x ∈ˢ Φ W j →
    77      ∃ (B : V) (g : V → ι × V), B ⊆ˢ A ∧ (∀ a, a ∈ˢ B → InFam W (g a)) ∧
    78        ∀ W', InUniv n W' → (∀ a, a ∈ˢ B → InFam W' (g a)) → x ∈ˢ Φ W' j

== whitepaper/Fragment/Access.lean#L80-L85
    80  /-- **Accessible operators are monotone**: the support in `W` is in
    81  the larger `W'`.  Con-leche: `AccTuple.monoTuple`. -/
    82  theorem AccFam.mono {n : Nat} {Φ : (ι → V) → ι → V} {A : V} (h : AccFam n Φ A) : MonoFam n Φ := by
    83    intro W W' hW hW' hle i x hx
    84    obtain ⟨B, g, -, hg, hs⟩ := h W hW i x hx
    85    exact hs W' hW' fun a ha => hle _ _ (hg a ha)

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L1050-L1075
  1050  /-- The codes of an instance's support, given the container values'
  1051  own supports `Bk` (by position). -/
  1052  noncomputable def instSupp (ps : List V) (c : CtorSpec) (fs : List V) (Bk : Nat → V) : V :=
  1053    listUnion ((List.range c.fields.length).map fun k =>
  1054      match c.fields[c.fields.length - 1 - k]? with
  1055      | some (.reflexive tele _) =>
  1056        image (pcons (nat k)) (ctxSet M (S.ψ ls) (consList (earlier fs k) (envP ps)) tele)
  1057      | some .container => image (pcons (nat k)) (Bk k)
  1058      | _ => empty)
  1059  
  1060  /-- The occurrence a code stands for: at a reflexive field, the field
  1061  at the code's position applied to the code's argument tuple, at the
  1062  field's index expressions there; at a container field, the container
  1063  value's own occurrence `gk` at the code, at the nested occurrence's
  1064  index expressions. -/
  1065  noncomputable def instOcc (ps : List V) (c : CtorSpec) (fs : List V) (gk : Nat → V → V) (b : V) :
  1066      List V × V :=
  1067    match c.fields[c.fields.length - 1 - idx (pfst b)]? with
  1068    | some (.reflexive _ es) =>
  1069      (S.idxVals M ls (consList (untuple (psnd b)) (consList (earlier fs (idx (pfst b))) (envP ps))) es,
  1070        appList (fieldVal fs (idx (pfst b))) (untuple (psnd b)).reverse)
  1071    | some .container =>
  1072      match S.nest with
  1073      | some N => (S.memberIdx M ls N ps, gk (idx (pfst b)) (psnd b))
  1074      | none => ([], pt)
  1075    | _ => ([], pt)

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L973-L995
   973  /-- **A constructor's support bound**: for each reflexive field, the
   974  tuples of its telescope at every list fitting the fields before it
   975  relative to the one-fibre family, each coded by the field's position
   976  (a numeral in a path step, `pcons`); for each container field, the
   977  class's bound, coded likewise.  An ordinary field contributes

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L632-L653
   632  /-- **The universe bound on the fields, at every family in the

== whitepaper/Fragment/Access.lean#L292-L303
   292  /-- **A closed family from accessibility.**  At a positive universe,
   293  an operator that maps families in the universe to families in the
   294  universe and is accessible with a bound `A` in the universe has a
   295  closed family in the universe: the limit family.  An element `Φ`
   296  produces from it has a support, each occurrence in some stage; the
   297  node whose subtree at `a` is a tree of the occurrence `g a`'s stage
   298  has that support in the union of its subtrees' stages, so its stage
   299  produces the element, which is therefore in the limit.  No
   300  monotonicity is used.  Con-leche: `closed_of_acc`,
   301  `ConLeche/SetModel/Access.lean`. -/
   302  theorem closed_of_acc (hn : n ≠ 0) (hA : A ∈ˢ (univ n : V)) (hmaps : MapsFam n Φ)
   303      (hacc : AccFam n Φ A) : ∃ L, IsClosedFam n Φ L := by

== ConLeche/SetModel/Access.lean#L239-L243
   239  /-- **(W) from accessibility.**  At a positive level, an operator that
   240  maps the tuple space into itself and is `A`-accessible for a set `A` of
   241  the level has a closed tuple.  No monotonicity is used. -/
   242  theorem closed_of_acc (hw : w ≠ 0) (hA : A ∈ˢ (univ w : V)) (hmaps : MapsTuple w k Is Φ)
   243      (hacc : AccTuple w k Is k Is Φ A) : ∃ L, IsClosedTuple w k Is Φ L := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/Access.lean#L163-L198
   163  /-- Lean-level well-founded trees branching over the sets: a leaf, or
   164  a node with a subtree for every set.  Con-leche: `BT`. -/
   165  inductive BT (V : Type u) : Type u
   166    | leaf : BT V
   167    | node : (V → BT V) → BT V
   168  
   169  namespace AccIter
   170  
   171  variable (Φ : (ι → V) → ι → V) (A : V)
   172  
   173  /-- The fibrewise union of an `A`-indexed family of families.
   174  Con-leche: `unionTup`. -/
   175  noncomputable def unionFam (F : V → ι → V) : ι → V := fun i => famUnion A fun a => F a i
   176  
   177  /-- **The stage at a tree**: the empty family at a leaf, `Φ` of the
   178  union of the subtrees' stages at a node.  Con-leche: `stage`. -/
   179  noncomputable def stage : BT V → ι → V
   180    | .leaf => fun _ => empty
   181    | .node f => Φ (unionFam A fun a => stage (f a))
   182  
   183  /-- **A tree's code**: its set of paths over `A` — the empty path at a
   184  node, and a step `a` onto every path of the subtree at `a`.
   185  Con-leche: `code`. -/
   186  noncomputable def code : BT V → V
   187    | .leaf => empty
   188    | .node f => binUnion one (famUnion A fun a => image (pcons a) (code (f a)))
   189  
   190  open Classical in
   191  /-- A tree with the given code, if any.  Con-leche: `pick`. -/
   192  noncomputable def pick (c : V) : BT V :=
   193    if h : ∃ T, code A T = c then Classical.choose h else .leaf
   194  
   195  /-- **The limit family**: the union of the stages over all codes.
   196  Con-leche: `limTup`. -/
   197  noncomputable def limFam : ι → V :=
   198    fun i => famUnion (power (accPaths A)) fun c => stage Φ A (pick A c) i

   304    refine ⟨limFam Φ A, limFam_mem hn hA hmaps, ?_⟩
   305    intro i x hx
   306    obtain ⟨B, g, hBA, hgL, hsupp⟩ := hacc _ (limFam_mem hn hA hmaps) i x hx
   307    -- every occurrence of the support lies in some stage: choose its tree
   308    have hT : ∀ a, a ∈ˢ B → ∃ T : BT V, (g a).2 ∈ˢ stage Φ A T (g a).1 :=
   309      fun a ha => mem_limFam.mp (hgL a ha)
   310    classical

   317      have : f a = Classical.choose (hT a ha) := dif_pos ha

   320    exact mem_limFam.mpr ⟨_, hstage⟩

    83  the intersection of the closed families when there is one, separated

    40  /-- **The subsingleton criterion, semantically**: at a proposition,
    41  at most one constructor, and every field of a fitting instance is

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Derive/LfpTuple.lean#L67-L75
    67  /-- **The least pre-fixed tuple of `Φ`** — componentwise, fibrewise the
    68  intersection of the closed tuples when there is one (separated from a
    69  chosen closed tuple), the empty tuple otherwise. -/
    70  noncomputable def lfpTuple (w k : Nat) (Is : Nat → V) (Φ : (Nat → V) → Nat → V) : Nat → V :=
    71    fun m =>
    72      if h : ∃ L, IsClosedTuple w k Is Φ L then
    73        graph (fun i => sep (app (Classical.choose h m) i)
    74          (fun x => ∀ X, IsClosedTuple w k Is Φ X → x ∈ˢ app (X m) i)) (Is m)
    75      else graph (fun _ => empty) (Is m)

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndRec.lean#L75-L83
    75  /-- **The operator** whose least fixed point is the recursor's graph:
    76  at the constructor value of fitting fields, the value is the
    77  constructor's minor at the fields and the inductive hypotheses.
    78  Con-leche: the graph functor `gStep` (`GraphRec.lean`). -/

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndLib.lean#L115-L118
   115  /-- **The least fixed point** of an operator on predicates: the
   116  intersection of every predicate closed under it. -/
   117  def Lfp {α : Sort _} (Φ : (α → Prop) → (α → Prop)) : α → Prop :=
   118    fun a => ∀ P : α → Prop, (∀ b, Φ P b → P b) → P a

   215  /-- **Totality of the graph on the family** (with single-valuedness,
   216  the recursion theorem): by induction over the family — at a
   217  constructor instance over the family's separation by "the graph has a
   218  value", every application of a reflexive field has one, and the
   219  inductive hypotheses' semantic values build the instance's.

    13  * **`huniq`** (`genUniq`): two decodings of a major are equal, or the
    14    motive's value at it is a subsingleton.  At `ℓ = 0` the bound is a truth
    15    value (from `hconclTy`); at a nonzero width the class's recorded clause
    16    injection is injective (`LfpClause.mkInj`), given the class's fit is the

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L84-L159
    84    /-- **ι** (`Red.iota`, `Rel.lean:184`): a stored recursor applied to
    85    exactly its telescope — `numParams` parameters, `numMotives` motives,
    86    `numMinors` minor premises, `numIndices` indices and the major
    87    premise — whose major reduces to a constructor application with a
    88    rule, fires the rule: the rule's right-hand side, at the use's
    89    levels, applied to the parameters, motives and minors, then to the
    90    constructor's fields (its arguments after the parameters).  The rule
    91    is one of the block's own constructors' (no stored instantiation,
    92    `RecRule.inst`); an auxiliary recursor's rule fires by
    93    `Red.iotaNested`.
    94  
    95    The two **telescope certificates** are `Rel.lean`'s `Certs` walks
    96    (`:576-587`) folded in: the recursor's argument spine (with the
    97    reduced major) and the constructor's argument spine are each typed
    98    against the stored type's `Π`-telescope — every argument's type is
    99    inferred and found definitionally equal to the binder domain it
   100    meets (`Expr.piDomains`), and the stored type has the spine's
   101    length of syntactic binders (`Expr.hasPis`; a generated type does).
   102    They are what makes the environment's ι law (`EnvModel.lean`,
   103    `RecRuleLaw`) applicable: they put every argument in its domain.
   104  
   105    The **three comparisons** after them are `Rel.lean`'s too
   106    (`:206-231`): the constructor's levels are the recursor's (its last
   107    `usj.length` ones — a large eliminator carries one extra level in
   108    front), the constructor's parameters are definitionally the
   109    recursor's, and the constructor's residual type
   110    (`Expr.piResidual`: the family at the constructor's own parameters
   111    and index expressions, with the fields substituted in) has index
   112    expressions definitionally equal to the recursor's index arguments.
   113    In the model they matter exactly when the family is a proposition:
   114    there the major denotes the one point, the certificates say only
   115    that the fibre is inhabited, and the fields the rule's right-hand
   116    side receives can be related to the recursor's own parameters and
   117    indices through these comparisons alone (`Install.lean`). -/
   118    | iota {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {us : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo}
   119        {numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat} {rules : List RecRule}
   120        {args : List Expr} {major : Expr} {cj : Name} {usj : List Level}
   121        {cij : ConstInfo} {margs : List Expr} {rl : RecRule}
   122        {doms tys doms' tys' : List Expr}
   123        {residual : Expr} {I : Name} {lsI : List Level} {rps ridx : List Expr} :
   124        env.find? c = some ci →
   125        ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   126        us.length = ci.lparams.length →
   127        args.length = numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices + 1 →
   128        ci.type.hasPis (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices + 1) = true →
   129        Red env Γ (args.getD (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) (bvar 0))
   130          major →
   131        major = mkAppN (const cj usj) margs →
   132        rl ∈ rules → rl.ctor = cj → rl.inst = none →
   133        env.find? cj = some cij →
   134        usj.length = cij.lparams.length →
   135        margs.length = numParams + rl.nfields →
   136        cij.type.hasPis (numParams + rl.nfields) = true →
   137        -- the recursor's telescope certificate, on the spine with the reduced major
   138        piDomains (ci.type.instL ci.lparams us)
   139          (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) ++ [major]) = some doms →
   140        tys.length = doms.length →
   141        (∀ p ∈ (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) ++ [major]).zip tys,
   142          Infer env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   143        (∀ p ∈ tys.zip doms, DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   144        -- the constructor's telescope certificate
   145        piDomains (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) margs = some doms' →
   146        tys'.length = doms'.length →
   147        (∀ p ∈ margs.zip tys', Infer env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   148        (∀ p ∈ tys'.zip doms', DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   149        -- the constructor's levels, parameters and residual indices against the recursor's
   150        Level.eqList usj (us.drop (us.length - usj.length)) = true →
   151        (∀ p ∈ (margs.take numParams).zip (args.take numParams), DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   152        piResidual (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) margs = some residual →
   153        residual = mkAppN (const I lsI) (rps ++ ridx) →
   154        rps.length = numParams →
   155        (∀ p ∈ ridx.zip ((args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices)).drop
   156          (numParams + numMotives + numMinors)), DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   157        Red env Γ (mkAppN (const c us) args)
   158          (mkAppN (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us)
   159            (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors) ++ margs.drop numParams))

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L178-L217
   178    /-- **ι** (`iotaRec`, `Kernel/Core.lean`): a stored recursor
   179    applied to exactly its telescope, whose prepared major (the `Red`
   180    premise: `prepareMajor`'s whnf / literal / rescue chain) is a
   181    constructor application with a firing rule.  The level comparands,
   182    the parameter comparison, the two licensed telescope certificates
   183    and the index comparison are the checker's, in its order. -/
   184    | iota {d : Nat} {e : Expr} {c : Name} {us : List Level} {cv : ConstantVal}
   185        {mI rP : Nat} {rules : List RecRule} {major : Expr} {cj : Name}
   186        {usj : List Level} {cvj : ConstantVal} {cnP cnF : Nat} {rl : RecRule}
   187        {residual : Expr} :
   188        e.getAppFn = .const c us →
   189        env.find? c = some (.recInfo cv mI rP rules) →
   190        e.getAppArgs.length = mI + 1 →
   191        us.length = cv.levelParams.length →
   192        Red env d (e.getAppArgs.getD mI (.bvar 0)) major →
   193        major.getAppFn = .const cj usj →
   194        env.find? cj = some (.ctorInfo cvj cnP cnF) →
   195        rules.find? (fun r' => r'.ctor == cj) = some rl →
   196        major.getAppArgs.length = rl.ctorParams + rl.nfields →
   197        rl.fire ≠ .inert →
   198        Level.isEquivList usj
   199          (recFireComparands rl cv.levelParams us cvj.levelParams
   200            e.getAppArgs rP).1 = some true →
   201        (rl.compareParams = true →
   202          DefEqList env d (major.getAppArgs.take rl.ctorParams)
   203            (recFireComparands rl cv.levelParams us cvj.levelParams
   204              e.getAppArgs rP).2) →
   205        Certs env d true (cv.type.instantiateLevelParams cv.levelParams us)
   206          (e.getAppArgs.take mI ++ [major]) →
   207        Certs env d true (cvj.type.instantiateLevelParams cvj.levelParams usj)
   208          major.getAppArgs →
   209        (mI ≠ rP →
   210          piResidual (cvj.type.instantiateLevelParams cvj.levelParams usj)
   211            major.getAppArgs = some residual) →
   212        (mI ≠ rP →
   213          DefEqList env d (residual.getAppArgs.drop rl.ctorParams)
   214            ((e.getAppArgs.take mI).drop rP)) →
   215        Red env d e
   216          (Expr.mkAppN (rl.rhs.instantiateLevelParams cv.levelParams us)
   217            (e.getAppArgs.take rP ++ major.getAppArgs.drop rl.ctorParams))

== ConLeche/Kernel/Env.lean#L265-L273
   265    /-- **The parameter-comparison bit** (install-computed, parse
   266    placeholder `false`): the ι step fires this rule without comparing
   267    the recursor's parameter arguments with the constructor's.  The
   268    installer and the pinned basis blocks set it, because their rule
   269    laws hold at any pair of fitting parameter spines; the projection
   270    functions do not, because their laws read the comparison.  The official
   271    kernel compares nothing here
   272    (`inductive_reduce_rec`), so a set bit is a step towards it. -/
   273    paramsBlind : Bool := false

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L77-L84
    77  /-- **Certificates give fit**: a spine whose arguments are typed against
    78  the telescope's domains (each argument's inferred type definitionally
    79  equal to the binder domain it meets) fits the telescope semantically —
    80  the folded `Certs` walk of `Red.iota`, made semantic. -/
    81  theorem teleFit_of_certs {Γ : List Expr} {ρ : Nat → V} (hs : Sat m.M φ Γ ρ) :
    82      ∀ {T : Expr} {spine tys doms : List Expr},
    83        WellDenoted m.M φ ρ T → (∀ a ∈ spine, WellDenoted m.M φ ρ a) →
    84        Expr.piDomains T spine = some doms → tys.length = doms.length →

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L201-L206
   201  /-- ι: the two certificates give the two telescope fits, the three
   202  comparisons give their semantic forms (the residual's index
   203  expressions are well-denoted because the residual is,
   204  `WellDenoted_piResidual`), the reduced major's denotation replaces the
   205  argument's, and the environment's `RecRuleLaw` gives the equation and
   206  the reduct's invariant. -/

== whitepaper/Fragment/EnvModel.lean#L102-L161
   102  /-- **The ι law of one recursor rule** (con-leche's `RecRuleLaw`,
   103  `ConLeche/Model/Annot/Laws.lean`), stated on **values**.  For the
   104  recursor `c` (stored as `ci`, with `numParams` parameters,
   105  `numBefore = numParams + numMotives + numMinors` arguments before the
   106  indices, the major at `majorIdx`) and its rule `rl` for the
   107  constructor stored as `cij`: whenever values `xs` up to the major,
   108  together with the constructor's set applied to values `ys` as the
   109  major, fit the recursor's telescope, `ys` fit the constructor's
   110  telescope, and the three comparisons of `Red.iota` hold in their
   111  semantic form — the constructor's levels evaluate as the recursor's
   112  last `usj.length` ones, its parameters ARE the recursor's, and the
   113  index expressions of its residual type (`piBodyV`: the family at the
   114  constructor's parameters and index expressions, read under the fields)
   115  denote the recursor's index arguments — then the recursor's set
   116  applied to the spine is the rule's right-hand side's set applied to
   117  the parameters, motives, minors and the fields; and the right-hand
   118  side is well-denoted, with a well-formed application chain along
   119  those values (which is what makes the reduct well-denoted,
   120  `WellDenoted_mkAppN_of_spineOk`).
   121  
   122  Values rather than terms so that the law mentions the model only at
   123  the STORED terms (the two types and the right-hand side): extending
   124  the environment by a fresh constant then leaves every old law intact
   125  (`Install.lean`), where a law over arbitrary argument terms would have
   126  to be re-proved for the terms that mention the new name.  The ι rule's
   127  soundness converts its term-level certificates to this form
   128  (`Tele.lean`).
   129  
   130  **Part 2's obligation, named.**  Where the family is a *type*, the
   131  law follows from the **fixpoint's inversion** alone: the recursor's
   132  fit puts the major — a tagged tuple of the fields — in the family at
   133  the RECURSOR's parameters and indices, and a member of the family
   134  built by `rl.ctor` has its fields in the constructor's field
   135  telescope at THOSE parameters, which is what the right-hand side's β
   136  steps need and what the recursion equation of the model's recursor is
   137  stated over.  Where the family is a *proposition* the major denotes
   138  the point and the fits say only that the fibre is inhabited; the
   139  three comparisons then relate the fields `ys` to the recursor's own
   140  parameters and indices, and the subsingleton criterion makes the
   141  recursor's value at the point the value at those fields. -/
   142  def RecRuleLaw (M : Name → List Nat → V) (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo)
   143      (numParams numBefore majorIdx : Nat) (rl : RecRule) (cij : ConstInfo) : Prop :=
   144    ∀ (φ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V) (us usj : List Level) (xs ys : List V),
   145      us.length = ci.lparams.length → usj.length = cij.lparams.length →
   146      xs.length = majorIdx → ys.length = numParams + rl.nfields →
   147      TeleFitV M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams us)
   148        (xs ++ [appList (M rl.ctor (usj.map (Level.eval φ))) ys]) →
   149      TeleFitV M φ ρ (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) ys →
   150      usj.map (Level.eval φ) = (us.drop (us.length - usj.length)).map (Level.eval φ) →
   151      ys.take numParams = xs.take numParams →
   152      (∀ (B : Expr) (ρ' : Nat → V) (I : Name) (lsI : List Level) (rps ridx : List Expr),
   153        piBodyV ρ (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) ys = some (B, ρ') →
   154        B = Expr.mkAppN (.const I lsI) (rps ++ ridx) → rps.length = numParams →
   155        ∀ p ∈ (ridx.map (interp M φ ρ')).zip (xs.drop numBefore), p.1 = p.2) →
   156      appList (M c (us.map (Level.eval φ)))
   157          (xs ++ [appList (M rl.ctor (usj.map (Level.eval φ))) ys])
   158        = appList (interp M φ ρ (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us))
   159            (xs.take numBefore ++ ys.drop numParams) ∧
   160      WellDenoted M φ ρ (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us) ∧
   161      SpineOk (interp M φ ρ (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us)) (xs.take numBefore ++ ys.drop numParams)

   367      (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat)
   368      (n : Name) (cv : ConstantVal) (mI rP : Nat) (rl : RecRule) :
   369      Prop :=

   207  theorem iota_sound [LevelOracle] {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {us : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo}
   208      {numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat} {rules : List RecRule}
   209      {args : List Expr} {major : Expr} {cj : Name} {usj : List Level}
   210      {cij : ConstInfo} {margs : List Expr} {rl : RecRule}
   211      {doms tys doms' tys' : List Expr} {numBefore majorIdx : Nat}
   212      {residual : Expr} {I : Name} {lsI : List Level} {rps ridx : List Expr}
   213      (hnB : numBefore = numParams + numMotives + numMinors)
   214      (hmI : majorIdx = numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices)
   215      (hfind : env.find? c = some ci)
   216      (hkind : ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules)
   217      (hus : us.length = ci.lparams.length)
   218      (hlen : args.length = majorIdx + 1)
   219      (hpis : ci.type.hasPis (majorIdx + 1) = true)
   220      (hmaj : RedSem m φ Γ (args.getD majorIdx (Expr.bvar 0)) major)
   221      (hmeq : major = Expr.mkAppN (Expr.const cj usj) margs)
   222      (hrl : rl ∈ rules) (hctor : rl.ctor = cj) (hinst : rl.inst = none)
   223      (hcij : env.find? cj = some cij)
   224      (husj : usj.length = cij.lparams.length)
   225      (hmlen : margs.length = numParams + rl.nfields)
   226      (hpis' : cij.type.hasPis (numParams + rl.nfields) = true)
   227      (hdoms : Expr.piDomains (ci.type.instL ci.lparams us) (args.take majorIdx ++ [major]) = some doms)
   228      (htys : tys.length = doms.length)
   229      (hI : ∀ p ∈ (args.take majorIdx ++ [major]).zip tys, InferSem m φ Γ p.1 p.2)
   230      (hD : ∀ p ∈ tys.zip doms, DefEqSem m φ Γ p.1 p.2)
   231      (hdoms' : Expr.piDomains (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) margs = some doms')
   232      (htys' : tys'.length = doms'.length)
   233      (hI' : ∀ p ∈ margs.zip tys', InferSem m φ Γ p.1 p.2)
   234      (hD' : ∀ p ∈ tys'.zip doms', DefEqSem m φ Γ p.1 p.2)
   235      (hlv : Level.eqList usj (us.drop (us.length - usj.length)) = true)
   236      (hP : ∀ p ∈ (margs.take numParams).zip (args.take numParams), DefEqSem m φ Γ p.1 p.2)
   237      (hres : Expr.piResidual (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) margs = some residual)
   238      (hshape : residual = Expr.mkAppN (Expr.const I lsI) (rps ++ ridx))
   239      (hrps : rps.length = numParams)
   240      (hX : ∀ p ∈ ridx.zip ((args.take majorIdx).drop numBefore), DefEqSem m φ Γ p.1 p.2) :
   241      RedSem m φ Γ (Expr.mkAppN (Expr.const c us) args)
   242        (Expr.mkAppN (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us) (args.take numBefore ++ margs.drop numParams)) := by
   243    intro ρ hs hw
   244    subst hnB hmI hmeq hctor
   245    -- every argument of the spine is well-denoted; the spine is `take ++ [major argument]`

== whitepaper/Fragment/InstallIota.lean#L687-L693
   687  /-- **The ι law of a generated rule** (`RecRuleLaw`, `EnvModel.lean`)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Consistency.lean#L36-L47
    36  /-- **The environments the checker accepts**: the empty environment,

== whitepaper/Fragment/Consistency.lean#L50-L55
    50  /-- An accepted environment is closed: its stored terms mention only
    51  stored constants, at their own level parameters. -/
    52  theorem Accepted.scoped : ∀ {env : Env}, Accepted env → Env.Scoped env
    53    | _, .empty => Env.Scoped.empty
    54    | _, .defn h hok => h.scoped.add_def hok
    55    | _, .ind S h hok => h.scoped.install_any hok

== whitepaper/Fragment/Consistency.lean#L57-L70
    57  /-- **Every accepted environment has a model** (in any `IndLib`) — a
    58  block model, which remembers its blocks for the nestings to come
    59  (`BlockModel.lean`). -/
    60  theorem accepted_model {env : Env} (h : Accepted env) : Nonempty (BlockModel V env) := by
    61    induction h with
    62    | empty => exact ⟨BlockModel.empty fun _ _ => pt⟩
    63    | defn h hok ih =>
    64      obtain ⟨m⟩ := ih
    65      obtain ⟨m', -⟩ := install_def' h.scoped m hok
    66      exact ⟨m'⟩
    67    | ind S h hok ih =>
    68      obtain ⟨m⟩ := ih
    69      obtain ⟨m', -⟩ := install_ind_any h.scoped m hok
    70      exact ⟨m'⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/Spec.lean#L43-L49

    46    `K.{lsK} args[nested]` lifted over the earlier fields; the field
