== whitepaper/Fragment/Spec.lean#L105-L136
   105  /-- **The class of a nested block**: the one container instantiation
   106  its container fields are read through — a previously installed block
   107  `K` (its data, as stored with its type former), at levels `lsK` over
   108  the block's level parameters, applied to arguments `args` (outermost
   109  first, under the block's parameters only; the nested position `p`
   110  omitted) with the nested occurrence `I params idx` at position `p` of `K`'s
   111  parameters.  `K` has parameters but no indices, and the nesting is at
   112  depth one: the nested occurrence is `K`'s argument directly.
   113  
   114  Con-leche: the container instance `C.{us} Ds` of the positivity walk
   115  (`Positivity.lean`, `contApp`) and the outside class of the recursor
   116  check (`GenRec.lean`, `ClassGen`); the fixture `tests/e2e/src/nested_rec.lean`
   117  has `K = List`, `args = []`, `p = 0`, `idx = []`. -/
   118  structure NestInfo where
   119    /-- The container's block data (as stored with its type former). -/
   120    K : IndBase
   121    /-- The container's levels at the instantiation, over the block's
   122    level parameters. -/
   123    lsK : List Level
   124    /-- The container's other arguments, outermost first, under the
   125    block's parameters (position `p` left out). -/
   126    args : List Expr
   127    /-- The nested position among the container's parameters
   128    (outermost first). -/
   129    p : Nat
   130    /-- The nested occurrence's index expressions, outermost first, under the
   131    block's parameters. -/
   132    idx : List Expr
   133    /-- The auxiliary recursor's name (`T.rec_1`): the recursor for the
   134    class. -/
   135    aux : Name
   136    deriving DecidableEq

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/Positivity.lean#L1406-L1415
  1406  /-- **The container case** of `nestPos`: the reduct `w` is the stored
  1407  inductive `n.{us}` applied to `args` (`contApp`), `rec` the walk
  1408  itself one fuel lower (at a frame's fields).  The container's
  1409  constructors are looked up by the names its record lists
  1410  (`nestContainer`); its checks (constructors
  1411  exist, enough arguments and hole-free indices, not `Quot`, parameters
  1412  without local variables); then the instantiation (`nestContKey`).  Split
  1413  off so that the monotonicity theorem can take the container case as its
  1414  own lemma. -/
  1415  def nestCont (ctx : NestCtx) (ops : CheckerOps m) (env : Env)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Spec.lean#L182-L208
   182  /-- **Strict positivity of the container in the nested
   183  position** (con-leche's `nestPos` walking the container's stored
   184  constructors at the instantiation, `Positivity.lean`): the container
   185  has no indices and no container field; the nested parameter's domain
   186  is a sort; no later parameter's domain mentions the nested parameter;
   187  every field of every constructor is the parameter field, a recursive
   188  field (reflexive with an empty telescope, and no index expressions),
   189  or an ordinary field whose domain mentions neither the nested
   190  parameter nor an earlier parameter field — the nested parameter never occurs to
   191  the left of an arrow, under a binder or inside another type, and
   192  nothing after a parameter field reads its value (the class is read at
   193  every approximant, so a parameter field's value must be free to
   194  move). -/
   195  def Positive : Prop :=
   196    N.K.indices = [] ∧
   197    N.p < N.nPK ∧
   198    (∃ ℓ : Level, N.K.params[N.nPK - 1 - N.p]? = some (.sort ℓ)) ∧
   199    (∀ i A, N.K.params[i]? = some A → i < N.nPK - 1 - N.p →
   200      A.usesVar (N.nPK - 2 - i - N.p) = false) ∧
   201    (∀ c ∈ N.K.ctors, c.idx = [] ∧ ∀ i f, c.fields[i]? = some f →
   202      match f with
   203      | Field.ordinary A => A = Expr.bvar (N.memberVar (c.fields.length - 1 - i)) ∨
   204          (A.usesVar (N.memberVar (c.fields.length - 1 - i)) = false ∧
   205            ∀ i' f', c.fields[i']? = some f' → i < i' →
   206              N.isMember (c.fields.length - 1 - i') f' = true → A.usesVar (i' - i - 1) = false)
   207      | Field.reflexive tele es => tele = [] ∧ es = []
   208      | Field.container => False)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/Positivity.lean#L260-L279
   260  **`nestPos`, the function**, by structural recursion on its fuel; its
   261  cases are the monotonicity induction's:
   262  
   263  * the whnf of the domain mentions no member — hole-free (`const`);
   264  * a `Π` whose domain mentions no member — recurse on the body (`pi`);
   265  * a hole at its frame's own parameters with hole-free indices, at its
   266    full arity (`holeApp`, official's `is_valid_ind_app` :338): a member
   267    hole — the ROOT frame's, at the block's parameters — or a container
   268    frame's (its instantiation in progress);
   269  * a stored inductive `C` (not a member) applied to parameters `Ds`
   270    (some mentioning a member, none a field or binder variable — official
   271    :962) and member-free indices (`contApp`): an instantiation IN
   272    PROGRESS is a `Y` hole; one already accepted is a cache hit; else its
   273    checks — (N2) the instantiated index telescope names no member
   274    (official checks the auxiliary type former before the block exists,
   275    :219), (N3) its sort `Level.isEquiv` the block's (:250) — and then
   276    `nestPos` on every field of every constructor of `C` AT the
   277    instantiation, the instantiation pushed onto the in-progress list,
   278    and the constructor's result indices member-free;
   279  * anything else — official's "non valid occurrence".

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/Positivity.lean#L1442-L1453
  1442  /-- **The positivity function** (see the section header): the domain
  1443  `e` at depth `dep`, `kb` `Π` binders into the field, `prog` the
  1444  instantiations in progress (innermost first; frame `i` from the
  1445  outside has its hole at `ctx.hiAt i`).  The block's members are HOLES
  1446  (the free variables `nP ..< nP + k`, abstracted by
  1447  `nestedBlockPositivity`), and so is each instantiation in progress (its
  1448  container abstracted to its frame's hole before its constructors are
  1449  instantiated) — so every hole the monotonicity induction varies is a
  1450  variable of the term `ops.whnf` reduces.  Throws official's verdict on
  1451  a non-positive or non-valid occurrence; returns the field's kind and
  1452  the cache. -/
  1453  def nestPos (ops : CheckerOps m) (env : Env) (ctx : NestCtx) :

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L760-L803
   760  /-- **A nested block is accepted** (con-leche's `checkBlock` with
   761  the positivity walk through the container and the generated recursors
   762  of every class, `Positivity.lean`, `GenRec.lean`): as `Ok` for the
   763  former and the constructors, and then
   764  
   765  * the container is stored with its specification, which is plain
   766    (depth one) and positive in the nested position;
   767  * the container's sort at the instantiation is the block's sort
   768    (official's N3), and so is the nested parameter's domain sort —
   769    the nested occurrence, a fibre of the block, is a member of that domain;
   770  * the class, at the block's parameters, has a sort in the environment
   771    holding the former: its arguments fit the container's parameters;
   772  * **large elimination is refused unless the sort is never `Prop`**
   773    (`blockLargeElimAllowed`, `BlockRec.lean:82`): the subsingleton
   774    criterion is never consulted for a nested block;
   775  * the two recursors' types and every rule's type have sorts in the
   776    environment holding the former and the constructors. -/
   777  def OkN (N : NestInfo) (env : Env) : Prop :=
   778    S.nest = some N ∧
   779    (S.name :: S.recName :: N.aux :: S.ctors.map (·.name)).Nodup ∧
   780    (∀ m ∈ S.name :: S.recName :: N.aux :: S.ctors.map (·.name), env.find? m = none) ∧
   781    S.Scoped env ∧
   782    (∃ T, Infer env [] S.indType T) ∧
   783    (∀ c ∈ S.ctors,
   784      (∃ T, Infer (S.envInd env) [] (S.ctorType c) T) ∧
   785      (∀ i A, (S.fieldCtx c.fields)[i]? = some A →
   786        ∃ s v, Infer (S.envInd env) ((S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params) A s ∧
   787          Red (S.envInd env) ((S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params) s (.sort v) ∧
   788          S.FieldBound v) ∧
   789      (∀ i tele es, c.fields[i]? = some (.reflexive tele es) → ∀ t T, tele[t]? = some T →
   790        ∃ s w, Infer (S.envInd env)
   791            (tele.drop (t + 1) ++ (S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params) T s ∧
   792          Red (S.envInd env) (tele.drop (t + 1) ++ (S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params)
   793            s (.sort w) ∧
   794          S.FieldBound w) ∧
   795      (∃ T, Infer (S.envCtors env) [] (S.ruleTypeN N c) T)) ∧
   796    (∃ ci, env.find? N.K.name = some ci ∧ ci.kind = .induct N.nPK 0 (N.K.ctors.map (·.name)) N.K.spec) ∧
   797    LevelOracle.eq (N.K.sort.subst N.K.lparams N.lsK) S.sort = true ∧
   798    LevelOracle.eq (N.memberLevel.subst N.K.lparams N.lsK) S.sort = true ∧
   799    (∃ T, Infer (S.envInd env) S.params (S.classTy N 0) T) ∧
   800    (S.large = true → S.NeverProp) ∧
   801    (∀ c ∈ N.K.ctors, ∃ T, Infer (S.envCtors env) [] (S.rule1Type N c) T) ∧
   802    (∃ T, Infer (S.envCtors env) [] (S.recTypeN N) T) ∧
   803    (∃ T, Infer (S.envCtors env) [] (S.rec1Type N) T)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L800

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/BlockRec.lean#L82-L84
    82  def blockLargeElimAllowed (p : BlockShape) (nested : Bool) : Bool :=
    83    p.resSort.isNeverZero ||
    84      (p.large && p.k == 1 && !nested && (p.numCtors == 0 || p.numCtors == 1))

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L349-L356
   349  /-- The container's field with `k` earlier fields, in the block's
   350  terms. -/
   351  def classField (N : NestInfo) (k : Nat) : Field → Field
   352    | .ordinary A =>
   353      if N.isMember k (.ordinary A) then .reflexive [] (N.idx.map (liftN k ·))
   354      else .ordinary (instChainAt (A.instL N.K.lparams N.lsK) (S.classArgs N 0) k)
   355    | .reflexive _ _ => .container
   356    | .container => .container

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L381-L383
   381  /-- A constructor of the container, in the block's terms: its fields

   383  def classCtor (N : NestInfo) (c : CtorSpec) : CtorSpec := ⟨c.name, S.classFields N c.fields, []⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L389-L391
   389  /-- **The class's motive's type**, under the parameters and the
   390  block's motive: `∀ (t : K args[nested]), Sort ℓ`. -/
   391  def motiveTy1 (N : NestInfo) : Expr := mkPis .never [S.classTy N 1] (.sort S.ℓ)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L404-L416
   404  /-- **A minor premise of the container's constructor `j`** at the
   405  instantiation: under the two motives, the block's minors and the `j`
   406  earlier class minors, `∀ fields ihs, motive_1 (C.{lsK} args[nested] fields)`
   407  — the fields the translated ones, a parameter field's hypothesis the
   408  block's motive at the nested occurrence, a container field's the class's. -/
   409  def minorTyK (N : NestInfo) (c : CtorSpec) (j : Nat) : Expr :=
   410    let c' := S.classCtor N c
   411    let nF := c'.fields.length
   412    let nIh := c'.recFields.length
   413    let o := 2 + S.n + j
   414    mkPis S.q (S.ihCtxAt c' o ++ S.fieldCtxAt c' o)
   415      (mkAppN (.bvar (nIh + nF + o - 2))
   416        [mkAppN (.const c.name N.lsK) (S.classArgs N (nIh + nF + o) ++ varsAt nIh nF)])

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L438-L450
   438  /-- **`T.rec`'s type** in a nested block:
   439  `∀ params motive motive_1 minors minors_1 indices (t : I params indices), motive indices t`. -/
   440  def recTypeN (N : NestInfo) : Expr :=
   441    mkPis S.q (S.recCtxN N) (mkAppN (.bvar (S.nI + S.oN N)) (varsAt 1 S.nI ++ [.bvar 0]))
   442  
   443  /-- The context of `T.rec_1`: the major at the class, the extras, the
   444  parameters. -/
   445  def rec1Ctx (N : NestInfo) : List Expr := S.classTy N (S.oN N) :: S.extrasN N ++ S.params
   446  
   447  /-- **`T.rec_1`'s type**: the same prefix, the major at the class,
   448  the class's motive at it. -/
   449  def rec1Type (N : NestInfo) : Expr :=
   450    mkPis S.q (S.rec1Ctx N) (mkAppN (.bvar (S.oN N - 1)) [.bvar 0])

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L452-L466
   452  /-- **An inductive hypothesis' value** in a rule of a nested block:
   453  `T.rec` at the field (under its telescope) for a reflexive field,
   454  `T.rec_1` at the field for a container field — each at the parameters
   455  and all the extras. -/
   456  def ihValN (N : NestInfo) (nF k : Nat) : Field → Expr
   457    | .ordinary _ => .sort .zero
   458    | .reflexive tele es =>
   459      let m := tele.length
   460      mkLams S.q (liftCtx (fun t T => atCtx nF k 0 (S.oN N) t T) tele)
   461        (mkAppN (.const S.recName S.recLvls)
   462          (varsAt (m + nF + S.oN N) S.nP ++ varsAt (m + nF) (S.oN N) ++
   463            es.map (atCtx nF k 0 (S.oN N) m) ++ [mkAppN (.bvar (m + nF - 1 - k)) (varsAt 0 m)]))
   464    | .container =>
   465      mkAppN (.const N.aux S.recLvls)
   466        (varsAt (nF + S.oN N) S.nP ++ varsAt nF (S.oN N) ++ [.bvar (nF - 1 - k)])

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L502-L509
   502  /-- **A `T.rec_1` rule's right-hand side** for the container's
   503  constructor `j`: `fun params motives minors fields => minor_1_j fields ihs`. -/
   504  def rule1Rhs (N : NestInfo) (c : CtorSpec) (j : Nat) : Expr :=

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L180-L187
   180  /-- **The generated recursor type** at class `c`. -/
   181  def classGenRecTy (g : ClassGen) (c : Nat) : Option Expr := do
   182    let pre := g.pre
   183    let rP := pre.length
   184    let (ifs, maj) ← g.major c rP
   185    let t : Expr := .fvar (rP + ifs.length) maj
   186    pure (closeTelescope (pre ++ ifs.map g.binder ++ [(maj, g.bm)]) 0
   187      (Expr.mkAppN (g.motVar c) (ifs ++ [t])))

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L189-L212
   189  /-- **The generated rule** of a recursor at class `c` for its constructor
   190  `x`: `λ p⃗ (prefix) f⃗, minor f⃗ (λ a⃗, rec_t p⃗ (prefix) e⃗ (f a⃗))…`, the
   191  callee `rec_t` the family's recursor at the landing class `t`
   192  (`recOf`). -/
   193  def classGenRule (g : ClassGen) (recOf : Nat → Option Name) (rlvls : List Level) (c : Nat)
   194      (x : ClassCtor) : Option Expr := do
   195    let pre := g.pre
   196    let rP := pre.length
   197    let (s, _) ← (List.range g.slots.length).zip g.slots |>.find? fun (_, sl) =>
   198      match sl with | .minor c' C _ => c' == c && C == x.cv.name | _ => false
   199    let (fvs, _) ← openPisAtFvars x.nF x.tyD rP
   200    let ws ← targetPiDomsWith fvs x.tyN
   201    let pvars := (List.range rP).map fun i => if i < g.nP then g.params.getD i default else
   202      g.slotVar (i - g.nP)
   203    let ihs ← (List.range x.nF).filterMapM fun i =>
   204      match x.kinds.getD i .ordinary with
   205      | .ordinary => some none
   206      | .recursive t tele => do
   207        let f := fvs.getD i default
   208        let (xs, idx) ← g.ihParts t tele (ws.getD i default) (rP + x.nF)
   209        let r ← recOf t
   210        pure (some (closeLams (xs.map g.binder) (rP + x.nF)
   211          (Expr.mkAppN (.const r rlvls) (pvars ++ idx ++ [Expr.mkAppN f xs]))))
   212    pure (closeLams (pre ++ fvs.map g.binder) 0 (Expr.mkAppN (g.slotVar s) (fvs ++ ihs)))

== ConLeche/Kernel/Env.lean#L196-L206
   196  * `.nested lvls pins` — a certified nested-auxiliary rule: the

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L160-L172

   161    a rule of an auxiliary recursor fires on a constructor of the

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/RecCheck.lean#L587-L597
   587  /-- **One checked recursor's stored rules, at its major**: `sumRules` at the
   588  MAJOR's parameter count and constructors;
   589  at an OUTSIDE major (a nested block's auxiliary recursor) every rule
   590  fires as `auxRuleFireR` reads it (`.nested` at the major's
   591  instantiation), at a member major as `sumRules` builds it. -/
   592  def tgtStoredRules (find? : Name → Option ConstantInfo) (resolves : Expr → Bool)
   593      (cv : ConstantVal) (mI rP : Nat) (M : TargetMajor) (rhss : List Expr) : List RecRule :=

   595    match M.member with

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L274-L294
   274  /-- **The set a field ranges over**, relative to a family `W` (index
   275  values to sets), at parameters `ps` and the earlier field values `fs`
   276  (innermost first): an ordinary field's domain; for a reflexive field
   277  the product over its telescope into the fibres of `W` at the field's
   278  index expressions read under the telescope's values — the fibre
   279  itself when the telescope is empty; for a container field the class
   280  at the fibre of `W` at the nested occurrence's index expressions
   281  (`classSet`: the container's family, read at the class's arguments
   282  with that fibre in the nested position; a plain block has no
   283  container field, and the clause is empty).  Con-leche: a field's
   284  reading with holes, `LfpDatum.fields`, read at the hole frame of the
   285  tuple (`HFits`, `BlockLfp.lean`); the container clause `contApp`
   286  through the container's lfp clause (`BlockLfpMono.lean`). -/
   287  def fieldSet (W : List V → V) (ps fs : List V) : Field → V
   288    | .ordinary A => interp M (S.ψ ls) (consList fs (envP ps)) A
   289    | .reflexive tele es =>
   290      piCtx M (S.ψ ls) (S.z ls) (consList fs (envP ps)) tele fun ρ' => W (S.idxVals M ls ρ' es)
   291    | .container =>
   292      match S.nest with
   293      | some N => S.classSet M ls N ps (W (S.memberIdx M ls N ps))
   294      | none => empty

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L452-L471
   452  /-- **The container's clause, as the operator needs it** at the
   453  parameters `ps` (see the section heading): the class is monotone in
   454  the parameter set, in the result universe, accessible with the class's
   455  bound, and inhabited at the one-fibre set when inhabited at all. -/
   456  structure ContClause (N : NestInfo) (ps : List V) : Prop where
   457    /-- The class grows with the parameter set. -/
   458    mono : ∀ X Y, X ⊆ˢ Y → X ∈ˢ (univ (S.u₀ ls) : V) → Y ∈ˢ (univ (S.u₀ ls) : V) →
   459      S.classSet M ls N ps X ⊆ˢ S.classSet M ls N ps Y
   460    /-- The class at a parameter set of the universe is in the universe. -/
   461    mem_univ : ∀ X, X ∈ˢ (univ (S.u₀ ls) : V) → S.classSet M ls N ps X ∈ˢ (univ (S.u₀ ls) : V)
   462    /-- Every member of the class at `X` has a support in `X`, coded in
   463    the class's bound, carrying it to the class at every parameter set
   464    holding the support. -/
   465    acc : ∀ X, X ∈ˢ (univ (S.u₀ ls) : V) → ∀ v, v ∈ˢ S.classSet M ls N ps X →
   466      ∃ (B : V) (g : V → V), B ⊆ˢ S.classBound ∧ (∀ b, b ∈ˢ B → g b ∈ˢ X) ∧
   467        ∀ X', X' ∈ˢ (univ (S.u₀ ls) : V) → (∀ b, b ∈ˢ B → g b ∈ˢ X') → v ∈ˢ S.classSet M ls N ps X'
   468    /-- The class at the one-fibre set is inhabited when the class at
   469    some parameter set of the universe is. -/
   470    inhab_one : ∀ X, X ∈ˢ (univ (S.u₀ ls) : V) → (∃ v, v ∈ˢ S.classSet M ls N ps X) →
   471      ∃ v, v ∈ˢ S.classSet M ls N ps one

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L596-L609
   596  /-- **A field's set grows with the family.** -/
   597  theorem fieldSet_mono {ps : List V} (hc : S.ContOk M ls ps) {W W' : List V → V}
   598      (hW : InUniv (S.u₀ ls) W) (hW' : InUniv (S.u₀ ls) W') (hle : FamLe W W') (fs : List V) :
   599      ∀ f : Field, S.fieldSet M ls W ps fs f ⊆ˢ S.fieldSet M ls W' ps fs f
   600    | .ordinary _ => Sub.refl _
   601    | .reflexive tele es => by
   602      simp only [fieldSet]
   603      exact piCtx_sub M _ (fun _ _ => hle _) fun hz _ _ => S.fibre_mem_univ_zero ls hW' hz _
   604    | .container => by
   605      cases hN : S.nest with
   606      | none => rw [S.fieldSet_container_none M ls hN]; exact empty_sub _
   607      | some N =>
   608        rw [S.fieldSet_container M ls hN, S.fieldSet_container M ls hN]
   609        exact (hc N hN).mono _ _ (hle _) (hW _) (hW' _)

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L973-L990
   973  /-- **A constructor's support bound**: for each reflexive field, the
   974  tuples of its telescope at every list fitting the fields before it
   975  relative to the one-fibre family, each coded by the field's position
   976  (a numeral in a path step, `pcons`); for each container field, the
   977  class's bound, coded likewise.  An ordinary field contributes
   978  nothing; a recursive field, whose telescope is empty, contributes the
   979  one tuple `tuple []` per prefix.  Con-leche: `piBound` glued along the
   980  telescope (`HoleAcc.lean`), made uniform along the fields
   981  (`TeleAcc.lean`); the container's bound `accPaths` of
   982  `ContAccFrame.lean`. -/
   983  noncomputable def ctorBound (ps : List V) (c : CtorSpec) : V :=
   984    listUnion ((List.range c.fields.length).map fun k =>
   985      match c.fields[c.fields.length - 1 - k]? with
   986      | some (.reflexive tele _) =>
   987        famUnion (S.fitsSet M ls oneFam ps (c.fields.drop (c.fields.length - k))) fun t =>
   988          image (pcons (nat k)) (ctxSet M (S.ψ ls) (consList (untuple t) (envP ps)) tele)
   989      | some .container => image (pcons (nat k)) S.classBound
   990      | _ => empty)

== whitepaper/Fragment/NestSem.lean#L385-L399
   385  /-- **A fitting list of a positive container stays fitting under a
   386  replacement**, at the parameter set and family the replacement reads:
   387  a parameter field's value lands in the new parameter set, a recursive
   388  field's in the new family's fibre, and an ordinary field — mentioning
   389  neither the nested parameter nor an earlier parameter or recursive field
   390  — reads the same set at both.  (The fields are a suffix of a

   398        Repl N Y W' fields fs fs' →

== whitepaper/Fragment/Access.lean#L411-L423
   411  /-- **The nested case: the least family is accessible in its
   412  parameter.**  If the joint operator (the parameter's indices on the
   413  left, its own on the right) is `A`-accessible and maps families in
   414  the universe to families in the universe, then `X ↦ lfpP Θ X` is
   415  `accPaths A`-accessible: by induction over the least family at `X`, a
   416  member's support is the paths through the operator's support — a leaf
   417  for an occurrence in `X`, the induction hypothesis' support below an
   418  occurrence in the least family — and every parameter holding it
   419  produces the member by the closedness of its least family.
   420  Con-leche: `lfpP_acc`. -/

== whitepaper/Fragment/NestSem.lean#L789-L798
   789  /-- **The container's clause, from positivity and leastness**
   790  (`ContClause`): the class is the container's family at the
   791  instantiation (`classSet_eq_Fam`), which grows with the parameter set
   792  (`Fam_psK_mono`), lies in the result universe (`Fam_mem_univ`, N3),

== whitepaper/Fragment/NestSem.lean#L195-L223
   195  /-- **What is known about the container** when a block nests through
   196  it: its set in the model is its family's graph (its installation's
   197  law), it is positive in the nested position, no field reads an
   198  earlier recursive field, the universe bound on its fields holds at
   199  every fitting parameter list (its own checks), the class's arguments
   200  fit its parameters at every parameter set in the result universe (the
   201  nested block's check), and its result universe at the instantiation
   202  is the block's (N3). -/
   203  structure NestFacts : Prop where
   204    /-- The container's set is its family's graph. -/
   205    fam : ∀ ls', M N.K.name ls' = N.KS.famSet M ls'
   206    /-- The container is positive in the nested position. -/
   207    positive : N.Positive
   208    /-- No field of the container reads an earlier recursive field. -/
   209    noRecDep : N.KS.NoRecDep
   210    /-- The universe bound on the container's fields, at fitting
   211    parameters. -/
   212    domsBounded : ∀ ps', FitsVals M (N.KS.ψ (S.lsK ls N)) base N.KS.params ps' →
   213      N.KS.DomsBounded M (S.lsK ls N) ps'
   214    /-- The class's arguments fit the container's parameters at every
   215    parameter set in the result universe. -/
   216    argsFit : ∀ ps, FitsVals M (S.ψ ls) base S.params ps → ∀ X, X ∈ˢ (univ (S.u₀ ls) : V) →
   217      FitsVals M (N.KS.ψ (S.lsK ls N)) base N.KS.params (S.psK M ls N ps X)
   218    /-- The container's result universe at the instantiation is the
   219    block's. -/
   220    u₀_eq : N.KS.u₀ (S.lsK ls N) = S.u₀ ls
   221    /-- The class's arguments fill all but the nested position of the
   222    container's parameters (`NestScoped`). -/
   223    args_len : N.args.length + 1 = N.nPK

== whitepaper/Fragment/BlockModel.lean#L46-L57
    46  /-- **The block's law** in a model: for a plain block, its scope, its
    47  constants stored, its former's set the family's graph, its
    48  constructors' sets their graphs, and the universe bound on its fields
    49  at fitting parameters.  Vacuous for a nested block. -/
    50  def BlockLaw (env : Env) (M : Name → List Nat → V) : Prop :=
    51    S.nest = none →
    52      S.Scoped env ∧ S.NoCont ∧
    53      env.find? S.name = some S.indInfo ∧
    54      (∀ (j : Nat) (c : CtorSpec), S.ctors[j]? = some c → env.find? c.name = some (S.ctorInfo c)) ∧
    55      (∀ ls, M S.name ls = S.famSet M ls) ∧
    56      (∀ (j : Nat) (c : CtorSpec), S.ctors[j]? = some c → ∀ ls, M c.name ls = S.ctorSet M ls j c) ∧
    57      (∀ ls ps, FitsVals M (S.ψ ls) base S.params ps → S.DomsBounded M ls ps)

== ConLeche/SetModel/NestRec.lean#L9-L19
     9  # The nested recursor's graph kit: majors over several CLASSES
    10  
    11  The graph kit (`SetModel/GraphRec.lean`, `GraphRecKit`) asks ONE thing of
    12  the majors: an induction principle (`ind`).  At a flat block the majors
    13  are the members' carriers and `ind` is the block's lfp induction.  At a
    14  NESTED block the recursor family also ranges over the CONTAINER CLASSES
    15  — `List Tree`, `Rose T`, `List (Rose T)` — each the least fixed point of
    16  its OWN operator, at its OWN instantiation (the container's lfp clause at
    17  the parameter frame the instantiation reads).  This module builds the
    18  kit over such a family of classes and proves `ind` from the classes'
    19  own clauses, by a STRENGTHENED PREDICATE:

== ConLeche/Model/Inductives/TargetNestKit.lean#L8-L19
     8  /-!
     9  # The nested recursor's classes as LFP CLAUSES
    10  
    11  The recursor model at a nested block (`graphRecPre_core`,
    12  `BlockRecGraph.lean`) is over the recursor's CLASSES: a member of the
    13  block, or a container at an instantiation (an outside major).  Charter
    14  item 5: "the model uses nothing from an inductive but its lfp clause" —
    15  so every class is presented by ONE recorded clause (`LfpClause`,
    16  `Model/Annot/BlockLfp.lean`) at a level assignment and a parameter
    17  frame, and this module turns clauses into the set-level kit
    18  `NestKit` (`SetModel/NestRec.lean`) whose induction the recursor's
    19  classes read (`NestNodeInd.ind_recNodesOn`, `SetModel/NestRecCls.lean`).

== whitepaper/Fragment/EnvModel.lean#L163-L190
   163  /-- **The ι law of a nested rule** (`Red.iotaNested`): for the
   164  recursor `c` with `numParams` parameters and a rule `rl` firing on a
   165  constructor `cij` of the block's container, with `nPc` parameters of
   166  its own — the comparisons against the stored instantiation are
   167  *checked* by the ι step, but the law does not consume them: the
   168  constructor's fields are pinned by the major's membership in the
   169  class (the recursor's telescope fit), as tags and tuples are
   170  injective, and the elimination level of a nested block whose sort may
   171  be `Prop` is `Prop` (`blockLargeElimAllowed`, `BlockRec.lean:82`),
   172  where the equation is trivial.  Otherwise as `RecRuleLaw`. -/
   173  def RecRuleLawN (M : Name → List Nat → V) (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo)
   174      (nPc numBefore majorIdx : Nat) (rl : RecRule) (cij : ConstInfo) : Prop :=
   175    ∀ (φ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V) (us usj : List Level) (xs ys : List V),
   176      us.length = ci.lparams.length → usj.length = cij.lparams.length →
   177      xs.length = majorIdx → ys.length = nPc + rl.nfields →
   178      TeleFitV M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams us)
   179        (xs ++ [appList (M rl.ctor (usj.map (Level.eval φ))) ys]) →
   180      TeleFitV M φ ρ (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) ys →
   181      (∀ (B : Expr) (ρ' : Nat → V) (I : Name) (lsI : List Level) (rps ridx : List Expr),
   182        piBodyV ρ (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) ys = some (B, ρ') →
   183        B = Expr.mkAppN (.const I lsI) (rps ++ ridx) → rps.length = nPc →
   184        ∀ p ∈ (ridx.map (interp M φ ρ')).zip (xs.drop numBefore), p.1 = p.2) →
   185      appList (M c (us.map (Level.eval φ)))
   186          (xs ++ [appList (M rl.ctor (usj.map (Level.eval φ))) ys])
   187        = appList (interp M φ ρ (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us))
   188            (xs.take numBefore ++ ys.drop nPc) ∧
   189      WellDenoted M φ ρ (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us) ∧
   190      SpineOk (interp M φ ρ (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us)) (xs.take numBefore ++ ys.drop nPc)

  2283  parameters, `nP + 2 + (n + nK)` arguments before the indices and the

  2288        (S.ctorInfo c) := by

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L18-L27
    18  * **The classes** (`checkBlockClasses`, in the install's PASS, before the
    19    positivity check).  An UNVERIFIED pre-pass (`ClassRead.lean`) reads the
    20    classes (one per motive), the prefix layout (motives, minor premises,
    21    their inductive hypotheses) and every recursor's class off the stream's
    22    RAW recursor types (they mention the constructors, so they are checked
    23    only here, at the constructors' environment).  Every class key is moved
    24    to the block's canonical parameters and annotated (`classKeyOf`), then
    25    checked as a major (`targetMajorOf`: a member at the block's levels and
    26    parameters, or a stored inductive at an auxiliary type of the block,
    27    `is_nested`), with exactly one class per member.

== whitepaper/Fragment/Lib.lean#L115-L121
   115  /-- The truth value of a proposition: `{pt}` if it holds, `∅` if
   116  not. -/
   117  def truthVal (P : Prop) : V := sep one (fun _ => P)
   118

   120  theorem mem_truthVal {p : Prop} {z : V} : z ∈ˢ truthVal p ↔ z = pt ∧ p := by
   121    unfold truthVal; rw [mem_sep, mem_one]

    68    match (p.members.getD mi default).ctors, (p.members.getD mi default).nIdx with
    69    | [c], nIdx =>
    70      { eta := nIdx == 0 && !p.isProp && !isRec

    74        unitlike := nIdx == 0 && c.2 == 0 && !isRec
    75        unitParams := p.nP

    77        sortZ := Level.zeronessOf p.resSort
    78        all := p.memberNames
    79        nparams := p.nP
    80        ctors := [c.1.name] }

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/BlockInstall.lean#L67-L80
    67  def blockCapsAt (p : BlockShape) (mi : Nat) (isRec : Bool) : IndCaps :=
    68    match (p.members.getD mi default).ctors, (p.members.getD mi default).nIdx with
    69    | [c], nIdx =>
    70      { eta := nIdx == 0 && !p.isProp && !isRec
    71        etaCtor := c.1.name
    72        etaParams := p.nP
    73        etaFields := c.2
    74        unitlike := nIdx == 0 && c.2 == 0 && !isRec
    75        unitParams := p.nP
    76        ruleK := p.k == 1 && c.2 == 0 && p.isProp
    77        sortZ := Level.zeronessOf p.resSort
    78        all := p.memberNames
    79        nparams := p.nP
    80        ctors := [c.1.name] }

== ConLeche/Kernel/Core.lean#L1861-L1890
  1861      | .letE ty v b => do
  1862        -- The body is annotated *with the value transparent* — nanoda's
  1863        -- `infer_let` instantiates the body with the value and recurses
  1864        -- (the official kernel gets the same transparency from valued
  1865        -- let-fvars in its local context).  ConLeche fvars carry no value,
  1866        -- so the body is annotated as its zeta reduct; an opened opaque
  1867        -- variable was tried and rejects real streams (elaborated `let`
  1868        -- bodies rely on the value definitionally — see DESIGN.md).
  1869        --
  1870        -- Task #217 (audit follow-up #206-S1): the official `infer_let`
  1871        -- triple — `ensure_sort_core(infer(type))`, `infer(val)`,
  1872        -- `is_def_eq(val_type, type)` — runs HERE, on the annotated
  1873        -- annotation and the annotated value, before the reduct is taken.
  1874        --
  1875        -- Task #161 item C2 dropped it as redundant with `inferBody`'s
  1876        -- own `.letE` clause.  That was wrong: this clause returns the ζ
  1877        -- reduct, so the stored term is let-free and `inferBody`'s
  1878        -- `.letE` arm never sees a `letE` node the driver produced —
  1879        -- `def x : Nat := let y : Nat := Bool.true; Nat.zero` was
  1880        -- accepted where the official kernel rejects ("(kernel)
  1881        -- let-declaration type mismatch").  The annotation pass is the
  1882        -- only pass that meets a `letE`, so it is where the triple must
  1883        -- run.
  1884        let ty' ← r.annotate depth ty
  1885        let _ ← ensureSort r env depth (← r.infer depth ty')
  1886        let v' ← r.annotate depth v
  1887        let tv ← r.infer depth v'
  1888        unless ← r.defeq depth tv ty' do
  1889          throw (.invalid "let value type mismatch")
  1890        r.annotate depth (b.instantiate1 v)

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L454-L459
   454  def checkDecls (mode : CheckMode) (pins : List NatOpPinSet)
   455      (ds : Array Declaration) :
   456      Except (CheckError × Nat) Env := do
   457    let (p, _) ← (ds.foldlM (annotDeclStep mode pins) (0, mkFEnv Env.empty, #[])) {}
   458    checkPendingList mode p.2.1 p.2.2.toList
   459    pure p.2.1.env

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L354-L365
   354  The driver's check phase — the in-thread loop or a pool of workers —
   355  runs `checkRecord` on every record.  Its result is the record's own
   356  evidence: on an accept the `GroupChecked` fact of that record, on a
   357  failure the error tagged with the record's fold position, the tag
   358  `checkPendingList` gives.  A worker hands back exactly this (a `Nat`
   359  and an erased proof, or the error), so the thread that computed a
   360  check is irrelevant to what it proves, and the results of any number
   361  of workers, in whatever order they finished, are assembled into
   362  `∀ i, GroupChecked mode e i` by `collectChecks` — a walk over the
   363  results in record order, which is also what makes the verdict of a
   364  pool the verdict of the walk `checkPendingList`: the first failing
   365  record in fold order.  Nothing here is `IO`. -/

== ConLeche/Semantics/Syntax.lean#L66-L90
    66  inductive AnnotTerm where
    67    /-- de Bruijn index -/
    68    | bvar (i : Nat)
    69    /-- `Sort u` at a concrete level -/
    70    | sort (u : Nat)
    71    /-- a built-in constant at a concrete level instantiation -/
    72    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
    73    /-- application -/
    74    | app (f a : AnnotTerm)
    75    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body`, where `body`'s **type** has sort `u` —
    76    the codomain numeral `interp` dispatches on (tier B's F4; the
    77    #152 resolution made it derivable, and `Annotates.lam` caches it) -/
    78    | lam (u : Nat) (ty body : AnnotTerm)
    79    /-- `(_ : ty) → body`, with `ty`'s sort `u` and `body`'s sort `v` -/
    80    | pi (u v : Nat) (ty body : AnnotTerm)
    81    /-- `@Eq _ lhs rhs`; no annotation, and no type slot either, as in
    82    `Term` (task #237) -/
    83    | eqE (lhs rhs : AnnotTerm)
    84    /-- first field of a pair -/
    85    | fst (e : AnnotTerm)
    86    /-- second field of a pair -/
    87    | snd (e : AnnotTerm)
    88    /-- the canonical (irrelevant) proof of a derivable equation -/
    89    | prf
    90    deriving Repr, Inhabited

   146      (d : Nat) → Expr → Option AnnotTerm
   147    | _, .sort u => some (.sort (u.eval φ))

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L150-L160
   150  noncomputable def interp : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → V
   151    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   152    | _, .sort u => univ u
   153    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   154    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)
   155    | ρ, .lam v A b => lamR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) b
   156    | ρ, .pi _ v A B => piR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B
   157    | ρ, .eqE a b => eqv (interp ρ a) (interp ρ b)
   158    | ρ, .fst e => sfst (interp ρ e)
   159    | ρ, .snd e => ssnd (interp ρ e)
   160    | _, .prf => pt

   571    | nil {d : Nat} {lic : Bool} {T : Expr} : Certs env d lic T []
   572    | skip {d : Nat} {lic : Bool} {ty body arg : Expr} {mb : BinderMeta}
   573        {rest : List Expr} :
   574        lic = true → mb.pw.isNever = true →
   575        Certs env d lic (body.instantiate1 arg) rest →
   576        Certs env d lic (.forallE ty body mb) (arg :: rest)
   577    | cert {d : Nat} {lic : Bool} {ty body arg ta : Expr} {mb : BinderMeta}
   578        {rest : List Expr} :
   579        Infer env .io d arg ta → DefEq env d ta ty →
   580        Certs env d lic (body.instantiate1 arg) rest →
   581        Certs env d lic (.forallE ty body mb) (arg :: rest)

== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L270-L290
   270  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   271    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   272    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   273    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   274    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   275    is closed) -/
   276    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   277      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   278    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   279    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   280      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   281    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   282    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   283    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   284    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   285    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   286    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   287    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   288      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   289      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   290      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

   226        ∀ ρ : Nat → V, WellDenotedV V ρ ta →
   227          Denotes (cvalOf (V := V) acval) env φ ρ (closeN d e) (interp V ρ ta) := by
